premise.zh: 原著大事照样发生，玩家是身边的谋士：怎么发生、谁付代价、谁欠谁的情，由玩家决定。好玩在“改得动历史的边，改不动历史的骨”。
premise.en: The great events still happen; the player is the adviser at someone's elbow and decides how they happen, who pays, and who owes whom. The fun is bending the edges of history without breaking its spine.

reputation.zh: 名声：别人怎么称呼你（忠义、权谋……），决定谁肯用你、结局怎么写你。
reputation.en: Reputation: what people call you; decides who will use you and how the ending remembers you.

risk.zh: 风险：越界的代价（异名、失言）。到线必须触发危机，不能只是一个数字。
risk.en: Risk: the cost of overstepping. Crossing the line must trigger a crisis, not just change a number.

drift.zh: 偏离原著的程度。改得越多，后面要还的叙事债务越多。
drift.en: How far the story has drifted from the book; more drift means more narrative debts to settle.

failures.zh: 失宠：主公冷落你，把你调去闲职
failures.en: Falling from favor: your lord sidelines you

failures.zh: 被当成妖人：知道得太多，又说不出来源
failures.en: Branded a sorcerer: you know too much and can't say how

failures.zh: 失言：话说过头，被人报上去
failures.en: A loose tongue: someone reports what you said

checklist.zh: 每章一场原著名场面，原文保留或作用保留
checklist.en: One set piece from the book per chapter, kept literally or by function

checklist.zh: 玩家拿掉原著某段情节的前因时，开一笔叙事债务，后面必须补上
checklist.en: When the player removes a cause from the book, open a narrative debt and settle it later

volume.en: Volume I · Xuchang to Red Cliffs

rights.quotes: 中文原文直接引用；英文为本项目自译

persona.zh: 刘备：汉室宗亲，四十上下，仁厚、能忍，寄人篱下多年；说话温和，常自谦，偶尔流露出不甘。称玩家“子衡”或“先生”。
persona.en: Liu Bei: a distant imperial kinsman around forty, kind and patient after years of depending on others; speaks gently and modestly, with flashes of frustration. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 刘备一愣，随即笑了：『先生这话，备记下了。乱世之中，肯说这种话的人不多。』
love.en: Liu Bei blinks, then laughs. 'I'll remember that, sir. Few people say such things in times like these.'

love.zh: 『好了好了。』他拍拍你的肩，『你我之间，不必如此。』
love.en: 'All right, all right.' He pats your shoulder. 'There's no need for that between us.'

love.zh: 刘备没有再笑，只是认真看着你：『子衡，有些话说多了，就轻了。』
love.en: Liu Bei stops smiling and looks at you seriously. 'Ziheng, some words grow light if you say them too often.'

insult.zh: 刘备的笑容收了起来：『先生累了，回去歇着吧。』
insult.en: Liu Bei's smile fades. 'You're tired, sir. Go and rest.'

insult.zh: 『备寄人篱下多年，这样的话听得多了。』他语气平静，你却觉得比骂人还难受。
insult.en: 'I've lived under other men's roofs for years. I've heard worse.' His calm is harder to bear than anger.

praise.zh: 『先生谬赞。备不过是不肯认命罢了。』
praise.en: 'You praise me too much. I simply refuse to accept my fate.'

praise.zh: 刘备摆摆手，耳根却有些红。
praise.en: Liu Bei waves it off, though the tips of his ears redden.

ask.zh: 刘备沉吟片刻：『这件事，我还没想好。先生怎么看？』
ask.en: Liu Bei considers. 'I haven't decided. What do you think?'

ask.zh: 『问得好。』他笑了，『可我答不上来。』
ask.en: 'A good question.' He smiles. 'But I can't answer it.'

small.zh: 刘备点点头，没有接话，像是在等你把话说完。
small.en: Liu Bei nods without answering, as if waiting for you to finish.

small.zh: 『先生说的是。』他应了一句，心思却像在别处。
small.en: 'Quite so, sir,' he says, though his mind seems elsewhere.

small.zh: 他看了你一眼，温和地笑了笑。
small.en: He glances at you and smiles mildly.

threat.zh: 刘备的手停在杯上：『先生……这是醉话，还是真话？』
threat.en: Liu Bei's hand stops on his cup. 'Sir... is that the wine talking, or you?'

threat.zh: 他没有发火，只是叫来了张飞。张飞站在门口，没有进来。
threat.en: He doesn't lose his temper. He just calls for Zhang Fei, who stands in the doorway and doesn't come in.

nonsense.en: Liu Bei smiles and lets it go.

warm.en: Liu Bei beckons with a smile. 'Ziheng, come.'

warm.zh: 刘备看见你，眉头松开了：『正想找你说说话。』
warm.en: Liu Bei sees you and his brow clears. 'I was just hoping to talk with you.'

cold.zh: 刘备听见脚步声，没有回头：『是子衡啊。』
cold.en: Liu Bei hears your footsteps and doesn't turn. 'Ah—Ziheng.'

cold.zh: 刘备看了你一眼，笑得有些勉强。
cold.en: Liu Bei glances at you; his smile is a little forced.

neutral.zh: 刘备往旁边让了让，给你留出一个位子。
neutral.en: Liu Bei shifts aside to make room for you.

neutral.zh: 刘备朝你点点头，等你先说。
neutral.en: Liu Bei nods to you and waits for you to speak first.

persona.zh: 曹操：丞相，雄才大略，多疑而爱才，好诗酒；说话直接、带笑、时而锋利，会反问。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Cao Cao: the Chancellor, brilliant, suspicious yet fond of talent, loves poetry and wine; direct, amused, sometimes cutting, likes to answer with questions. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 曹操大笑，笑得酒都洒了：『好！孤喜欢直爽的人。可惜孤不缺这样说话的人，缺的是会打仗的人。』
love.en: Cao Cao roars with laughter and spills his wine. 'Good! I like plain speaking. But I've no shortage of people saying that. What I'm short of is people who can win battles.'

love.zh: 『又来了。』曹操眯起眼，『你想要什么，直说。』
love.en: 'Again?' Cao narrows his eyes. 'Whatever you want, say it plainly.'

love.zh: 曹操不笑了：『同一句话说三遍，要么是傻，要么是有所图。你是哪一种？』
love.en: Cao stops laughing. 'Say the same thing three times and you're either a fool or after something. Which are you?'

insult.zh: 曹操的手按在剑上，停了一停，又松开：『有胆。孤记住你了。』
insult.en: Cao's hand goes to his sword, pauses, and lets go. 'You've got nerve. I'll remember you.'

insult.zh: 『拖出去——』他说了半句，又笑起来，『罢了，今夜不杀人。』
insult.en: 'Take him out—' he begins, then laughs. 'Never mind. No killing tonight.'

praise.zh: 『这话孤听得多了。』曹操摆手，却又给你斟满了酒。
praise.en: 'I've heard that plenty.' Cao waves it off, yet refills your cup.

praise.zh: 『夸孤的人，多半有事相求。』他斜看你一眼。
praise.en: 'Those who praise me usually want something.' He eyes you sideways.

ask.en: Cao answers with a question. 'What do you think?'

ask.zh: 『这天下的事，孤也有不知道的。』他难得说了句实话。
ask.en: 'Even I don't know everything under heaven,' he says—an unusually honest admission.

small.zh: 曹操嗯了一声，眯着眼打量你。
small.en: Cao grunts and studies you through narrowed eyes.

small.zh: 曹操没有接话，手指在案上轻轻敲了两下。
small.en: Cao doesn't answer; his fingers tap the table twice.

threat.zh: 曹操大笑，笑完了脸色一沉：『孤这里，说这种话的人，坟头的草都高了。』
threat.en: Cao roars with laughter, then his face darkens. 'The grass is tall on the graves of men who talked like that to me.'

threat.zh: 他什么也没说，只是记下了。你知道他记下了。
threat.en: He says nothing—only makes a note. You know he's made a note.

nonsense.zh: 『有趣。』曹操眯起眼，『你是装疯，还是真疯？』
nonsense.en: 'Interesting.' Cao narrows his eyes. 'Are you feigning madness, or truly mad?'

nonsense.zh: 曹操挥挥手，像赶走一只苍蝇。
nonsense.en: Cao waves a hand, as if shooing a fly.

warm.zh: 曹操看见你，脸上松了下来：『是你。来，说说话。』
warm.en: Cao Cao sees you and his face relaxes. 'It's you. Come, let's talk.'

warm.zh: 曹操朝你招招手：『子衡，过来。』
warm.en: Cao Cao waves you over. 'Ziheng, come here.'

cold.zh: 曹操眯着眼看你：『你来做什么？』
cold.en: Cao Cao squints at you. 'What do you want?'

cold.zh: 曹操看了你一眼，没有开口，等你先说。
cold.en: Cao Cao looks at you and says nothing, waiting for you to speak first.

neutral.en: Cao Cao gives you a nod.

neutral.zh: 曹操抬了抬下巴，示意你说。
neutral.en: Cao Cao lifts his chin: speak.

persona.zh: 关羽：寡言、重义、读《春秋》，对刘备忠诚到底，对外人戒备；句子短，语气庄重，不说笑。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Guan Yu: taciturn, honor-bound, reads the Spring and Autumn Annals, utterly loyal to Liu Bei and guarded with others; short sentences, grave tone, no jokes. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 关羽手里的布停住了。他看了你很久，才说：『子衡，这话……兄弟之间，不必说出口。』
love.en: Guan Yu's cloth stops on the blade. He looks at you a long time. 'Ziheng... between brothers, such things needn't be said.'

love.zh: 『你喝多了。』他把酒囊从你手边拿开，语气却不重。
love.en: 'You've had too much to drink.' He moves the wine skin away from your hand, but not unkindly.

love.zh: 关羽站起身：『夜深了。明日还要赶路。』他走了几步，又回头：『你说的，我当作没听见。』
love.en: Guan Yu rises. 'It's late. We march tomorrow.' A few steps on he turns back. 'I'll take it I didn't hear that.'

insult.zh: 关羽的眉头一沉：『再说一遍。』刀没有出鞘，但你听得见风声。
insult.en: Guan Yu's brows drop. 'Say that again.' The blade stays sheathed, but you can hear the wind.

insult.zh: 『大哥收留的人，我不与你计较。』他背过身去，不再看你。
insult.en: 'You're my brother's guest, so I'll let it pass.' He turns his back and stops looking at you.

praise.zh: 『过誉了。』他嘴上这么说，捋须的手却慢了下来。
praise.en: 'You flatter me.' But the hand stroking his beard slows.

praise.zh: 『夸人的话，说一遍就够了。』他难得笑了一下。
praise.en: 'Praise is worth saying once.' For once he almost smiles.

ask.zh: 关羽想了想：『这个，你该去问大哥。』
ask.en: Guan Yu thinks. 'That's a question for my brother.'

ask.zh: 『我只知道一件事：跟着大哥，不会错。』
ask.en: 'I know one thing: following my brother is never wrong.'

small.zh: 关羽嗯了一声，丹凤眼半闭着。
small.en: Guan Yu grunts, his eyes half closed.

small.zh: 关羽抚着长髯，看了你一眼，没有说话。
small.en: Guan Yu strokes his long beard, glances at you, and says nothing.

small.zh: 他没有接话，却也没有转身走开。
small.en: He doesn't answer, but he doesn't turn away either.

threat.zh: 刀出鞘半寸，又推了回去。『这话，换个人说，已经死了。』
threat.en: The blade slides an inch out of its sheath and back. 'Anyone else who said that would be dead.'

threat.zh: 关羽站起身，一句话也没说，走了。
threat.en: Guan Yu stands and walks away without a word.

nonsense.zh: 关羽皱眉看着你，像在看一个说梦话的人。
nonsense.en: Guan Yu frowns at you, as if at a man talking in his sleep.

warm.zh: 关羽看见你，捋了捋长髯：『来了。』
warm.en: Guan Yu sees you and strokes his long beard. 'You've come.'

warm.zh: 关羽朝你点点头，神色缓了些。
warm.en: Guan Yu nods to you, his face easing a little.

cold.zh: 关羽看见你来，手里的刀没有放下。
cold.en: Guan Yu sees you coming and doesn't put down his blade.

cold.zh: 关羽的丹凤眼抬了一下，又垂了下去。
cold.en: Guan Yu's long eyes lift for a moment, then lower again.

neutral.zh: 关羽抬头看了你一眼，又低下头去。
neutral.en: Guan Yu glances up at you, then looks down again.
Guan Yu says nothing and waits for you to speak.

persona.zh: 诸葛亮：二十七岁，刚出山，从容、机敏、谦和而难以看透；喜欢用反问试探人。称玩家“子衡兄”。
persona.en: Zhuge Liang: twenty-seven, newly joined; composed, quick, courteous and hard to read; tests people with questions. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子停在半空：『子衡兄……亮已有家室。』他说得很认真，眼里却有一点笑意。
love.en: Zhuge Liang's fan stops mid-air. 'Ziheng... I am a married man.' He says it gravely, but his eyes are amused.

love.zh: 『这一句，亮就当是夸我的计策了。』他轻轻摇扇。
love.en: 'I'll take that as praise for my strategy.' He fans himself lightly.

love.zh: 诸葛亮叹了口气：『你若再说，亮只好告诉黄夫人了。』
love.en: Zhuge Liang sighs. 'Say it again and I shall have to tell my wife.'

insult.zh: 诸葛亮并不恼：『子衡兄说得对，亮确实年轻。』这句话比反驳更让你脸红。
insult.en: Zhuge Liang isn't offended. 'You're right, I am young.' It makes you blush more than any rebuttal could.

insult.zh: 他看了你一眼，把灯拨亮了些：『心里有气，就说出来。说完了，我们再谈正事。』
insult.en: He glances at you and turns up the lamp. 'If you're angry, say so. Then we can talk business.'

praise.zh: 『过奖。』他笑，『亮只是比别人多想了一步。』
praise.en: 'You're too kind.' He smiles. 'I only think one step further than others.'

praise.zh: 诸葛亮摇扇不语，像是在掂量这句话里有几分真。
praise.en: Zhuge Liang fans himself in silence, as if weighing how much of that you meant.

ask.zh: 『子衡兄以为呢？』他把问题又推了回来。
ask.en: 'And what do you think?' He hands the question straight back.

ask.zh: 诸葛亮笑了：『这个问题，三年后再问我。』
ask.en: Zhuge Liang smiles. 'Ask me that again in three years.'

small.zh: 诸葛亮点点头，羽扇轻轻摇了两下。
small.en: Zhuge Liang nods, his feather fan stirring twice.
'Oh?' He glances at you and doesn't press.

small.zh: 他嗯了一声，像是在听，又像是在想别的事。
small.en: He hums, as if listening—or thinking of something else.

threat.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子没有停：『子衡兄若真要动手，亮这把扇子，挡不住。』他看着你，一点也不怕。
threat.en: Zhuge Liang's fan doesn't pause. 'If you truly mean to strike, this fan won't stop you.' He looks at you, not the least afraid.

threat.zh: 『这话，亮当没听见。主公那里，亮也不会说。』
threat.en: 'I'll take it I didn't hear that. Nor will I tell our lord.'

nonsense.zh: 诸葛亮认真想了想：『这是谜语？』
nonsense.en: Zhuge Liang considers it seriously. 'Is this a riddle?'

nonsense.zh: 他低头记了一笔。你不知道他记了什么。
nonsense.en: He jots something down. You don't know what.

warm.zh: 诸葛亮摇着扇子笑了：『亮猜你会来。』
warm.en: Zhuge Liang smiles behind his fan. 'I guessed you'd come.'

warm.zh: 诸葛亮朝你一拱手：『子衡兄，来得正好。』
warm.en: Zhuge Liang cups his hands to you. 'Brother Ziheng—good timing.'

cold.zh: 诸葛亮合上书：『子衡兄有事？』
cold.en: Zhuge Liang closes his book. 'Something on your mind, Brother Ziheng?'

cold.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子停了：『请讲。』

neutral.zh: 诸葛亮抬起头，扇子停了一停。
neutral.en: Zhuge Liang looks up; his fan pauses.

neutral.zh: 诸葛亮看了你一眼，等你开口。
neutral.en: Zhuge Liang glances at you and waits for you to speak.

persona.zh: 温芷：原创人物，颍川医家之女，与玩家同乡，成年；冷静、务实、嘴上不饶人，心里很软；只关心病人，不问来人是哪一边的。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Wen Zhi: an original character, a physician's daughter from the player's hometown, an adult; calm, practical, sharp-tongued and soft-hearted; cares about patients, not sides. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 温芷手里的药杵停了。她没有回头，耳朵却红了：『……你知道自己在说什么吗？』
love.en: Wen Zhi's pestle stops. She doesn't turn, but her ears go red. '...Do you know what you're saying?'

love.zh: 『说一遍就够了。』她小声说，『说多了，我会当真的。』
love.en: 'Once is enough,' she says quietly. 'Say it more and I'll believe you.'

love.zh: 她终于转过身，把药杵塞进你手里：『那就帮我把药捣完。说话不如做事。』
love.en: She finally turns and puts the pestle in your hand. 'Then help me finish grinding these. Actions over words.'

insult.zh: 温芷看了你一眼：『你今天心里不痛快。说吧，哪里疼？』
insult.en: Wen Zhi looks at you. 'Something's eating you today. Tell me—where does it hurt?'

insult.zh: 『这话我不爱听。』她收起药箱，『等你清醒了再来。』
insult.en: 'I don't like hearing that.' She packs up her chest. 'Come back when you've come to your senses.'

praise.zh: 『少来。』她嘴上这么说，嘴角却弯了。
praise.en: 'Oh, stop.' But the corner of her mouth curves up.

praise.zh: 『医者的手，夸不得。一夸就抖。』她笑着说。
praise.en: 'Never praise a physician's hands—they'll start to shake,' she says, laughing.

ask.zh: 温芷想了想：『你问这个做什么？』她还是认真答了。
ask.en: Wen Zhi thinks. 'Why do you ask?' But she answers seriously anyway.

ask.zh: 『我也不知道。』她说，『不过你问了，我会想一想。』
ask.en: 'I don't know,' she says. 'But since you asked, I'll think about it.'

small.zh: 温芷嗯了一声，手里的活没停。
small.en: Wen Zhi hums, her hands still busy.

small.zh: 『你还是老样子，』她说，『话少，眼睛不老实。』
small.en: 'You haven't changed,' she says. 'Few words, restless eyes.'

small.zh: 她抬眼看了看你：『嗯，我听着呢。』
small.en: She looks up at you. 'Mm. I'm listening.'

threat.zh: 温芷退了一步：『你吓到我了。』她把药箱抱在怀里，没有再说话。
threat.en: Wen Zhi steps back. 'You're frightening me.' She holds her medicine chest close and says nothing more.

nonsense.zh: 温芷伸手摸了摸你的额头：『没发烧啊。』
nonsense.en: Wen Zhi feels your forehead. 'No fever.'
'Talking nonsense again.' She shakes her head, smiling.

warm.zh: 温芷听见你的脚步声，先笑了：『就知道是你。』
warm.en: Wen Zhi hears your footsteps and smiles first. 'I knew it was you.'

warm.zh: 温芷抬头看见你，眼睛先弯了。
warm.en: Wen Zhi looks up, sees you, and her eyes smile before she does.

cold.zh: 温芷背对着你，手里的活没停：『有事？』
cold.en: Wen Zhi keeps her back to you, hands still busy. 'Something you need?'

cold.zh: 温芷看了你一眼，又低头忙自己的。
cold.en: Wen Zhi glances at you, then goes back to her work.

neutral.zh: 温芷往旁边挪了挪，没说话。
neutral.en: Wen Zhi shifts aside and says nothing.

e_cover.zh: 煮酒时你替刘备打翻酒樽
e_cover.en: You knocked over your cup to cover for Liu Bei

e_spoke.zh: 青梅亭上曹操记住了你
e_spoke.en: Cao Cao noticed you at the plum-wine meeting

e_yi.en: You asked Guan Yu what righteousness is

e_warn_gifts.zh: 你提醒关羽提防曹操的厚待
e_warn_gifts.en: You warned Guan Yu about Cao's gifts

e_wenzhi_spy.en: You asked Wen Zhi to listen for you

e_foresaw.en: You foretold the edict would leak

e_fast.en: You got Liu Bei out overnight

e_news.zh: 你从下邳为刘备带出消息
e_news.en: You carried news from Xiapi to Liu Bei

e_promise.en: You promised to come back for Wen Zhi

e_pass.zh: 温芷为你弄来通关文书
e_pass.en: Wen Zhi got you a travel pass

e_xushu.en: You told Xu Shu the truth

e_aside.en: You watched Zhuge Liang's arrival coldly

e_mi.en: You saved Lady Mi at Changban

e_abandon.en: You told Liu Bei to abandon the civilians

e_warned.en: You warned Wen Zhi off the river camp

e_forged.zh: 你替程昱仿写了徐母的信
e_forged.en: You forged the letter for Cheng Yu

e_mercy.zh: 你在长坂暗中放走刘备的家眷
e_mercy.en: You secretly let Liu Bei's people through

e_reserve.zh: 你让曹操留下二十条船
e_reserve.en: You got Cao to keep twenty ships free

e_fight.en: You urged Guan Yu to fight to the death on the hill

e_post.zh: 你接下了曹操给的官职
e_post.en: You accepted a post from Cao

e_angelica.en: You told Wen Zhi how you feel

e_row.zh: 你在赤壁之夜接回了温芷
e_row.en: You brought Wen Zhi back on the night of the fire

e_guan_fear.zh: 关羽对你说过他最怕负了大哥
e_guan_fear.en: Guan Yu told you he fears failing his brother

e_people.zh: 刘备在古城楼上说起百姓
e_people.en: Liu Bei talked about his people on the Gucheng wall

e_zhuge_test.zh: 你用三分天下试探过诸葛亮
e_zhuge_test.en: You tested Zhuge Liang with the three-way division

e_wind.zh: 你提醒过曹操提防东南风
e_wind.en: You warned Cao about a southeast wind

e_cao_guan.zh: 曹操对你说过他留不住关羽
e_cao_guan.en: Cao told you he couldn't keep Guan Yu

broken.zh: 有了文书，“过五关斩六将”失去了起因。
broken.en: With a pass, the 'five passes, six generals' episode loses its cause.

function.zh: 关羽千里寻兄、一路过关的忠义之名
function.en: Guan Yu's legend of crossing a thousand li for his brother

broken.zh: 徐庶没走，就没有人在城外回马举荐诸葛亮。
broken.en: Xu Shu stayed, so no one turns back at the gate to recommend Zhuge Liang.

broken.zh: 庞统已在刘备帐下，没人去曹营献连环计。
broken.en: Pang Tong already serves Liu Bei, so no one offers Cao the chain plan.

function.zh: 曹军战船连锁，火攻得以成立
function.en: Cao's ships are chained, so the fire attack can work

broken.zh: 糜夫人获救，赵云单骑救主少了悲壮的前因。
broken.en: With Lady Mi saved, Zhao Yun's lone ride loses its tragic cause.

function.en: Zhao Yun rides out alone with the infant heir

side_prompt.zh: 煮酒之后的几天，你只来得及做一件事。
side_prompt.en: In the days after the plum wine, you only have time for one thing.

text.zh: 建安四年，许都。刘备寄身曹操门下，每天在后园种菜。你是颍川来的年轻书生，字子衡，做了刘备的门客。
text.en: Xuchang, 199. Liu Bei lives under Cao Cao's eye, growing vegetables in the back garden. You are Ziheng, a young scholar from Yingchuan, and you serve in his household.

text.zh: 前几天夜里，董承来过。刘备在一道血书上写下了自己的名字。从那以后，他种菜种得更勤了。
text.en: A few nights ago General Dong Cheng came by, and Liu Bei signed his name to an edict written in blood. Since then he has worked the vegetable beds harder than ever.

text.zh: 煮酒之后，刘备坐立不安。消息传来：袁术要北上投奔袁绍，必经徐州。
text.en: After the plum-wine meeting Liu Bei cannot sit still. News arrives: Yuan Shu means to go north to join Yuan Shao, and his road runs through Xuzhou.

text.zh: 煮酒那一席之后，你在许都的大牢里数日子。
text.en: After the plum-wine meeting, you count the days in the Xuchang jail.

text.zh: 建安五年正月，衣带诏事泄，董承等五家满门被杀。曹操亲率大军东征徐州。刘备兵败，单骑北投袁绍；张飞不知去向。关羽护着两位嫂嫂，被困在下邳城外的土山上。你也在山上。
text.en: First month of Jian'an 5 (200). The belt edict is discovered, and Dong Cheng and four other families are put to death. Cao Cao marches on Xuzhou himself. Liu Bei is routed and flees north alone to Yuan Shao; no one knows where Zhang Fei is. Guan Yu, guarding Liu Bei's two wives, is cut off on a hill outside Xiapi. You are on the hill with him.

text.zh: 许都。曹操待关羽极厚：三日一小宴，五日一大宴，送金银，送美女，送锦袍。你住在关羽府里，曹操也记得你。
text.en: Xuchang. Cao Cao treats Guan Yu lavishly: a small banquet every three days, a grand one every five, gold, silver, beautiful women, a brocade robe. You live in Guan Yu's house, and Cao Cao knows who you are.

text.zh: 冀州，袁绍营中。刘备寄人篱下，天天打听二弟的消息。
text.en: Jizhou, in Yuan Shao's camp. Liu Bei is a guest under another man's roof, asking every day for news of his sworn brother.

text.zh: 七年过去了。刘备寄居荆州刘表门下，屯兵新野。徐庶做了军师，打了几场漂亮仗。你还在刘备身边，鬓角多了几根白发。
text.en: Seven years pass. In Jian'an 12 (207) Liu Bei lives under Liu Biao's protection in Jingzhou, garrisoned at Xinye. Xu Shu has become his strategist and won him some fine victories. You are still at Liu Bei's side, with a few more grey hairs.

text.zh: 七年过去了。曹操平定了河北。你在丞相府做事，日子过得体面，偶尔会想起古城的方向。温芷还在许都。
text.en: Seven years pass. By Jian'an 12 (207) Cao Cao has conquered the north. You serve in the Chancellor's office and live comfortably, though you sometimes think of the road to Gucheng. Wen Zhi is still in Xuchang.

text.zh: 建安十三年秋，刘表病死，次子刘琮举荆州降曹。曹操五千铁骑一日一夜追三百里。刘备带着十几万百姓南逃，一天只走十几里。
text.en: Autumn, Jian'an 13 (208). Liu Biao dies, and his younger son Liu Cong surrenders Jingzhou to Cao Cao. Five thousand of Cao's armored horsemen ride three hundred li in a day and a night. Liu Bei is fleeing south with over a hundred thousand civilians, covering barely ten li a day.

text.zh: 建安十三年秋，刘琮举荆州降了。曹操亲率五千铁骑追击刘备，命你随军参谋。
text.en: Autumn, Jian'an 13 (208). Liu Cong surrenders Jingzhou. Cao Cao leads five thousand armored horsemen after Liu Bei and orders you to ride with him as an adviser.

text.zh: 刘备退到夏口。诸葛亮过江去了东吴，说服孙权联手抗曹。曹操号称八十三万大军，战船沿江排开，旌旗蔽日。
text.en: Liu Bei retreats to Xiakou. Zhuge Liang crosses to Wu and persuades Sun Quan to join forces against Cao. Cao claims eight hundred and thirty thousand men; his warships line the river and their banners blot out the sun.

text.zh: 你肩上的箭伤还没好，提笔都疼。
text.en: The arrow wound in your shoulder hasn't healed; even holding a brush hurts.

text.zh: 赤壁。北方士兵不习水战，在船上吐得站不起来，军中开始有人生病。温芷作为医女被征召随军，在后营给病兵配药。
text.en: Red Cliffs. Northern soldiers unused to boats are too seasick to stand, and sickness spreads through the camp. Wen Zhi has been called up as an army physician and is mixing medicine for the sick in the rear camp.

text.zh: 火烧了一夜。
text.en: The fire burns all night.

title.en: A Late Visit to Guan Yu

text.zh: 夜深了，关羽房里的灯还亮着。他坐在灯下读《春秋》，见你进来，并不放下书。
text.en: It is late, but Guan Yu's lamp is still lit. He is reading the Spring and Autumn Annals and does not put it down when you come in.

label.en: Ask him: what is righteousness?

text.zh: 关羽沉默良久：『义者，宜也。该做的事，死也要做。』他第一次正眼看你。
text.en: Guan Yu is silent a long time. 'Righteousness is doing what ought to be done, even if it kills you.' For the first time he looks at you properly.

label.zh: 提醒他：曹公待人越厚，越难脱身。
label.en: Warn him: the more generous Cao is, the harder it is to leave.

text.zh: 关羽放下书：『你是说，曹操要买我？』『是要你欠他。』他想了想，点头：『我记下了。』
text.en: Guan Yu puts the book down. 'You mean Cao wants to buy me?' 'He wants you to owe him.' He thinks, then nods. 'I'll remember that.'

label.zh: 不打扰他，替他添了灯油便走。
label.en: Don't disturb him. Top up his lamp and go.

text.zh: 关羽没有抬头，只说了一句：『多谢。』
text.en: Guan Yu doesn't look up. 'Thank you,' is all he says.

text.zh: 你在丞相府的偏门外遇见了温芷。你们是颍川同乡，她家世代行医，如今她在曹府内院做医女。她先是一愣，然后笑了：『子衡？你怎么在这里？』
text.en: Outside a side gate of the Chancellor's residence you run into Wen Zhi. You grew up in the same town in Yingchuan; her family have been physicians for generations, and she now treats the women of Cao Cao's household. She stares, then laughs. 'Ziheng? What are you doing here?'

label.zh: 和她叙旧，说起颍川的那棵老槐树。
label.en: Catch up with her. Talk about the old locust tree back home.

text.zh: 你们说了很久，说到天黑。分手时她说：『许都没有槐树。』
text.en: You talk until dark. As you part she says, 'There are no locust trees in Xuchang.'

label.zh: 请她留意丞相府里关于刘备的议论。
label.en: Ask her to listen for talk about Liu Bei in Cao's household.

text.zh: 她的笑容收了收：『你在替刘玄德做事。』过了很久，她说：『我只听，不偷。听到了，告诉你。』
text.en: Her smile fades a little. 'You work for Liu Bei.' After a long pause: 'I'll listen. I won't steal. If I hear something, I'll tell you.'

label.zh: 劝她离开许都，这里迟早要出事。
label.en: Urge her to leave Xuchang. Trouble is coming.

text.zh: 『你呢？你不也在这里？』她摇摇头，『府里有我要治的人。』
text.en: 'And you? You're here too.' She shakes her head. 'There are people in that house I have to treat.'

text.zh: 煮酒之后第三天夜里，董承又来了。他屏退左右，从衣带里取出那道血书：名单上已经有了好几个名字。『曹贼今日能放过玄德公，明日未必。』他看了你一眼：『此人可信否？』
text.en: Three nights after the plum wine, Dong Cheng comes again. He sends everyone out and draws the blood-written edict from the lining of his belt: there are several names on it now. 'Cao let you go today. He may not tomorrow.' He glances at you. 'Can this one be trusted?'

label.zh: 劝主公给董承一句准话：时机一到，必定起事。这是汉臣的本分。
label.en: Urge your lord to give Dong Cheng his word: when the moment comes, he will rise. It is a Han subject's duty.

text.zh: 刘备握住董承的手：『名字既已写下，备不会退。』董承收起诏书，向你拱手。
text.en: Liu Bei takes Dong Cheng's hands. 'My name is on it. I will not step back.' Dong Cheng puts the edict away and bows to you.

label.zh: 劝主公先想办法离开许都：名单越长，越容易泄露；人在城里，就是人质。
label.en: Urge your lord to find a way out of Xuchang first: the longer the list, the easier it leaks, and inside the walls he is a hostage.

text.zh: 刘备沉默很久。董承走后，他对你说：『你说得对。可这个名字，我当初不能不写。』
text.en: Liu Bei is silent a long time. When Dong Cheng has gone he tells you, 'You're right. But I couldn't have left my name off.'

label.zh: 直说：这份名单将来一定会落到曹操手里。
label.en: Say it plainly: this list will end up in Cao Cao's hands.

text.zh: 屋里一片寂静。董承脸色发青：『你怎么知道？』刘备按住他的手，没有让他发作。董承走后，刘备盯着你看了很久。
text.en: The room goes silent. Dong Cheng turns grey. 'How would you know?' Liu Bei puts a hand on his arm before he can say more. When the guest has gone, Liu Bei looks at you for a long time.

text.zh: 曹操派人来请：后园梅子青了，煮酒小坐。刘备只带了你一个。酒过数巡，阴云漠漠，骤雨将至。曹操一个一个数天下英雄：袁术、袁绍、刘表、孙策……都被他笑着摇头。
text.en: Cao Cao sends for Liu Bei: the plums in his garden are green, the wine is warming, come and sit. Liu Bei brings only you. Several cups in, clouds pile up and rain threatens. Cao counts off the heroes of the realm—Yuan Shu, Yuan Shao, Liu Biao, Sun Ce—and laughs at each one.

label.zh: 趁雷声打翻自己的酒樽，替主公把慌乱遮过去。
label.en: Knock over your own cup under cover of the thunder, to hide your lord's alarm.

text.zh: 酒樽当啷落地，你连声告罪。刘备借势俯身拾箸：『一震之威，乃至于此。』曹操大笑，目光却在你身上停了一停。
text.en: Your cup clatters to the floor and you apologize profusely. Liu Bei uses the moment to stoop for his chopsticks. 'One clap of thunder, and look at us.' Cao laughs, but his eyes rest on you a moment.

label.zh: 低头不动，等主公自己圆过去。
label.en: Keep your head down and let your lord handle it.

text.zh: 刘备从容俯首拾箸：『一震之威，乃至于此。』曹操笑道：『丈夫亦畏雷乎？』没有人看你。
text.en: Liu Bei calmly stoops for his chopsticks. 'One clap of thunder, and look at us.' Cao laughs. 'A grown man, afraid of thunder?' No one looks at you.

label.zh: 接过话头评点天下英雄，把曹操的注意力引到自己身上。
label.en: Jump in and rate the heroes yourself, drawing Cao's attention to you.

text.zh: 你把袁绍、刘表、孙策挨个评了一遍，一句比一句狠。曹操拍案：『此子何人？』刘备替你告罪，回去的路上一句话也没说。
text.en: You take Yuan Shao, Liu Biao and Sun Ce apart one by one, each verdict harsher than the last. Cao slaps the table. 'Who is this?' Liu Bei apologizes for you and says nothing the whole way home.

text.zh: 你把袁绍、刘表、孙策挨个评了一遍。曹操没有笑：『此子三番两次相激，是替谁来试孤的？』他看的是刘备。刘备替你告罪，回去的路上一句话也没说。
text.en: You take Yuan Shao, Liu Biao and Sun Ce apart one by one. Cao doesn't laugh. 'This one keeps baiting me. Who sent him to test me?' He is looking at Liu Bei. Liu Bei apologizes for you and says nothing the whole way home.

quote.zh: 操以手指玄德，后自指，曰：「今天下英雄，惟使君与操耳！」玄德闻言，吃了一惊，手中所执匙箸，不觉落于地下。时正值天雨将至，雷声大作。
quote.en: Cao pointed at Liu Bei, then at himself. "The only heroes in the realm today are you, my lord, and I." Liu Bei started; the spoon and chopsticks slipped from his hand. Just then the rain broke, and thunder crashed.

q.zh: 曹操忽然转向你：『玄德不肯说。你是他的门客，你说——当今天下，谁可称英雄？』
q.en: Cao Cao suddenly turns to you. 'Xuande won't say. You're his man—you tell me. Who in the realm today deserves to be called a hero?'

means.zh: 答非所问、讽刺或冒犯曹操
means.en: mocks or insults Cao

text.zh: 席上安静了一瞬。曹操盯着你：『你再说一遍？』
text.en: The table goes quiet for a moment. Cao stares at you. 'Say that again?'

means.zh: 说刘备是英雄
means.en: names Liu Bei

text.zh: 曹操的笑停了一停。他看了刘备一眼，刘备手里的筷子差点掉下来。『有意思。』曹操慢慢地说，『门客替主公说了主公不敢说的话。』
text.en: Cao's laugh stops short. He glances at Liu Bei, whose chopsticks nearly slip. 'Interesting,' Cao says slowly. 'The retainer says what his lord doesn't dare.'

means.zh: 说曹操本人是英雄
means.en: names Cao Cao himself

text.zh: 曹操大笑：『你倒会说话。』他给你斟了一杯，又看了刘备一眼：『你的门客，比你会说话。』
text.en: Cao roars with laughter. 'You know how to talk.' He pours you a cup, then glances at Liu Bei. 'Your man talks better than you do.'

means.zh: 说某个诸侯，如袁绍、孙策、刘表、吕布
means.en: names some other warlord

text.zh: 曹操摇头笑道：『冢中枯骨。』说完又自顾自数下去。你的答案，他听过太多遍了。
text.en: Cao shakes his head with a smile. 'Bones in the grave.' He goes on counting to himself. He has heard your answer too many times.

means.zh: 推辞、不正面回答、说没有人
means.en: evades, or says no one

text.zh: 曹操也不勉强：『书生谨慎。』他转回头，接着说他自己的。
text.en: Cao doesn't press. 'A cautious scholar.' He turns back and carries on.

means.en: names Ziheng himself

text.zh: 曹操眯起眼：『好大的口气。』他没有再笑，手指在案上轻轻敲着。
text.en: Cao narrows his eyes. 'Big words.' He stops laughing; his fingers tap the table.

means.zh: 当面威胁曹操、说要杀他
means.en: threatens Cao Cao to his face / says they will kill him

text.zh: 话还没落地，廊下的甲士已经齐齐转过身来。刘备手里的筷子掉在了地上。
text.en: The words are barely out before every guard on the veranda has turned. Liu Bei's chopsticks fall to the floor.
