means.zh: 劝曹操杀了刘备、除掉刘备
means.en: urges Cao Cao to kill Liu Bei / get rid of him

text.zh: 梅园里一下子静了。刘备端着酒，没有动。曹操看看你，又看看刘备，忽然大笑：『子衡这话，是替孤试玄德，还是替玄德试孤？』他笑够了，摆摆手：『孤若杀英雄，天下谁还敢来投孤？』
text.en: The garden goes silent. Liu Bei holds his cup and doesn't move. Cao Cao looks at you, then at Liu Bei, and bursts out laughing. 'Ziheng—are you testing Xuande for me, or testing me for Xuande?' When he's done laughing he waves a hand. 'If I killed heroes, who in the realm would dare come to me?'

text.zh: 刘备放下酒杯，从这一刻起，再没有看你一眼。
text.en: Liu Bei sets down his cup, and from this moment on he doesn't look at you once.

moves.match: 杀了?(他|刘备|玄德|刘使君)|除掉(他|刘备)|刘备(不可|留不得)|此人(当|必|不可不)除|留(他|此人)不得|kill (him|liu bei)|get rid of (him|liu bei)

means.zh: 对曹操说刘备才是真英雄
means.en: tells Cao Cao that Liu Bei is the true hero

text.zh: 曹操拊掌：『子衡与孤，所见略同。』他笑着给刘备斟满酒，眼睛却一直没离开刘备的脸。刘备在桌下踩了你一脚。
text.en: Cao Cao claps his hands. 'Ziheng and I see alike.' Smiling, he fills Liu Bei's cup, but his eyes never leave Liu Bei's face. Under the table Liu Bei steps on your foot.

moves.match: (刘(备|使君|皇叔)|玄德).{0,6}(才|就|乃)?是.{0,4}英雄|英雄.{0,6}(刘(备|使君|皇叔)|玄德)|liu bei is the (true |real )?hero

means.zh: 悄悄提醒刘备：曹操起疑了，早点离开许都
means.en: quietly warns Liu Bei that Cao suspects him and he should leave Xuchang

text.zh: 刘备在桌下按住你的手，面上照旧笑着给曹操斟酒。曹操的目光在你们两人之间转了一圈。
text.en: Under the table Liu Bei presses your hand, still smiling as he pours for Cao Cao. Cao Cao's gaze travels once between the two of you.

moves.match: 快走|离开许都|早(点|些)?(走|离开)|出城|小心曹操|曹操(要|想)杀你|leave xuchang|get out|be careful of cao

text.zh: 温芷托人送来一包药，药包里夹着一张纸条：『郭、程二人劝丞相，不可放刘备出城。』
text.en: Wen Zhi sends over a packet of medicine. Folded inside is a note: 'Guo Jia and Cheng Yu are urging the Chancellor not to let Liu Bei leave the city.'

label.zh: 劝主公一拿到兵马就连夜出城。
label.en: Urge your lord to leave the night he gets his troops.

text.zh: 刘备点头：『就这么办。』当夜大军出了许都。
text.en: Liu Bei nods. 'So be it.' That night the army leaves Xuchang.

label.zh: 烧掉纸条，托人带话：别再为我冒险。
label.en: Burn the note and send word: don't take risks for me again.

text.zh: 回话只有两个字：『知道。』你不确定她是生气还是放心。
text.en: The reply is two words: 'I know.' You can't tell whether she's angry or relieved.

text.zh: 她说过『只听，不偷』。这张纸条，已经是在偷了。
text.en: She said she would listen, not steal. This note is stealing.

text.zh: 刘备想出城，却需要一个曹操驳不回的理由。
text.en: Liu Bei needs a reason to leave that Cao Cao cannot refuse.

label.en: Advise him to volunteer to intercept Yuan Shu.

text.zh: 次日刘备入朝请命，曹操竟然准了，拨给他五万兵马。
text.en: The next day Liu Bei volunteers at court, and Cao agrees, giving him fifty thousand men.

label.zh: 主张托病闭门，等风头过去。
label.en: Suggest he plead illness and wait it out.

text.zh: 刘备摇头：『闭门是等死。』他最后还是请命截击袁术。
text.en: Liu Bei shakes his head. 'Hiding at home is waiting to die.' In the end he volunteers to intercept Yuan Shu anyway.

label.zh: 直说：曹操很快会后悔，要走就趁今夜。
label.en: Say it plainly: Cao will regret this soon. If we go, we go tonight.

text.zh: 刘备看了你一眼，没有问为什么。次日入朝请命截击袁术，当夜就出了城。
text.en: Liu Bei looks at you and doesn't ask why. He volunteers at court the next day, and leaves that same night.

text.zh: 大军出城没多久，后面尘头大起：许褚带着五百骑追来，说丞相请将军回去。
text.en: Not long after the army leaves, dust rises behind you: Xu Chu with five hundred riders. The Chancellor asks the general to return.

text.zh: 大军连夜赶路。第二天中午，探马来报：许褚带五百骑追到半路，见追不上，回去了。
text.en: The army marches through the night. At noon the next day, scouts report that Xu Chu came after you with five hundred riders, saw he couldn't catch up, and turned back.

text.zh: 刘备在马上回头找你，把自己的备马让给了你：『子衡，跟紧我。』
text.en: Liu Bei looks back for you from the saddle and gives you his spare horse. 'Ziheng, stay close.'

text.zh: 刘备打马先走了。你跟在队伍后面，没有人回头等你。
text.en: Liu Bei spurs ahead. You ride at the back of the column; no one turns to wait for you.

text.zh: 许褚追得格外急。梅园那天之后，曹操就没再放心过刘备。
text.en: Xu Chu rides harder than anyone. Since the day in the plum garden, Cao has never trusted Liu Bei.

text.zh: 你背上的棍伤还没好，马每颠一下都疼。
text.en: The welts on your back haven't healed; every jolt of the saddle hurts.

label.zh: 请主公答他：『将在外，君命有所不受。』
label.en: Have your lord answer: 'A general in the field need not obey every order.'

text.zh: 许褚是个直人，听了这话，竟无话可说，回去复命了。
text.en: Xu Chu is a plain man. He has no answer to that and rides back to report.

label.zh: 你亲自出面，跟许褚东拉西扯，拖到天黑。
label.en: Go out yourself and talk Xu Chu in circles until dark.

text.zh: 许褚被你绕得头昏，拨马回去了。曹操听说后问：『跟许褚说话的那个书生，叫什么？』
text.en: Xu Chu gets so tangled he turns his horse and goes home. When Cao hears about it he asks, 'The scholar who talked to Xu Chu—what's his name?'

hint.zh: 许褚认得你——梅园那天之后，丞相府的人都认得你
hint.en: Xu Chu knows your face. Since the plum garden, everyone in the Chancellor's household does

label.en: Ride on.

text.zh: 徐州就在前面。
text.en: Xuzhou lies ahead.

label.zh: 回头望一眼许都的方向。
label.en: Look back toward Xuchang.

text.zh: 城楼已经看不见了。温芷还在那里。
text.en: The city walls are out of sight. Wen Zhi is still there.

text.zh: 要是晚走半天，就得在城门口跟许褚说话了。你想起那包药。
text.en: Half a day later and you'd have been arguing with Xu Chu at the gate. You think of the medicine packet.

text.zh: 张辽单骑上山，劝关羽暂降。他说关羽若死战，有三罪：负了桃园之誓，负了皇叔托付的两位嫂嫂，负了匡扶汉室之志。关羽沉默了。
text.en: Zhang Liao rides up the hill alone to urge Guan Yu to surrender for now. If he fights to the death, Zhang Liao says, he commits three wrongs: he breaks the Peach Garden oath, abandons the two ladies his brother entrusted to him, and gives up on restoring the Han. Guan Yu says nothing.

text.zh: 关羽没有看张辽，看的是你：『你说，怎么办。』
text.en: Guan Yu doesn't look at Zhang Liao. He looks at you. 'You tell me. What now?'

text.zh: 关羽没有看你。篝火边那句冲撞他的话，他还记着。
text.en: Guan Yu doesn't look at you. He hasn't forgotten what you threw at him by the campfire.

text.zh: 关羽瞥了你一眼：『篝火边那些话，我当你是年轻。今天，说正事。』
text.en: Guan Yu glances at you. 'What you said by the fire—I'll put it down to youth. Today we talk business.'

label.zh: 替关羽把条件写下来，一条一条和张辽谈。
label.en: Write down Guan Yu's conditions and negotiate them with Zhang Liao point by point.

text.zh: 你执笔，关羽口述，三条写得清清楚楚：『吾今只降汉帝，不降曹操』；两位嫂嫂由皇叔俸禄供养，闲人不得入门；『但知刘皇叔去向，不管千里万里，便当辞去』。张辽带回去，曹操全都答应了。关羽随曹军入许都，你也一起去了。
text.en: Guan Yu dictates and you write, three terms set down plainly: 'I surrender to the Han emperor, not to Cao Cao'; the two ladies are to be kept on Liu Bei's stipend and no one may enter their gate; 'the moment I learn where Liu Bei is, however far, I leave.' Zhang Liao takes them back and Cao agrees to all three. Guan Yu goes to Xuchang with Cao's army, and you go with him.

label.zh: 趁夜突围北上，去袁绍那里给主公报信。
label.en: Break out at night and ride north to bring your lord the news.

text.zh: 关羽给了你一匹马：『告诉大哥，我在，嫂嫂在。』你从山后的小路走了。后来听说，关羽与曹操约了三件事，随曹军入了许都。
text.en: Guan Yu gives you a horse. 'Tell my brother: I'm alive, and so are the ladies.' You slip away down the back of the hill. Later you hear that Guan Yu agreed three terms with Cao and went to Xuchang with his army.

label.en: Urge Guan Yu to fight to the death rather than surrender.

text.zh: 关羽摇头：『你说的，正是我想说的。可两位嫂嫂怎么办？』他还是派张辽回去传话，约了三件事。你随他入了许都。
text.en: Guan Yu shakes his head. 'You're saying what I want to say. But what becomes of the two ladies?' He sends Zhang Liao back with three terms after all. You go to Xuchang with him.

text.zh: 关羽转头看你：『你问过我什么是义。今天这道题，难。』
text.en: Guan Yu turns to you. 'You once asked me what righteousness is. Today the question is hard.'

text.zh: 你想起那天夜里在董承面前说的话。消息传开后，有人说刘备府上有个书生，早就算到了。
text.en: Word gets around that a scholar in Liu Bei's household saw this coming.

text.zh: 你想起篝火边他说的话：最怕负了大哥。
text.en: You remember what he said by the fire: what he fears is failing his brother.

text.zh: 曹操把吕布的赤兔马送给关羽。关羽再拜称谢——金银美女都没让他拜过。曹操有些不快：『为何独重一马？』关羽答得坦然。曹操沉默片刻，转向你：『子衡也该有个官职。』
text.en: Cao Cao gives Guan Yu Lü Bu's horse, Red Hare. Guan Yu bows twice in thanks—gold and women never got a bow from him. Cao is put out. 'Why does a horse matter more than all the rest?' Guan Yu answers frankly. Cao is quiet a moment, then turns to you. 'Ziheng ought to have a post too.'

label.zh: 接下曹操给的主簿之职。
label.en: Accept the clerk's post Cao offers.

text.zh: 曹操很高兴。关羽看了你一眼，什么也没说。
text.en: Cao is pleased. Guan Yu glances at you and says nothing.

label.zh: 婉拒：『在下是关将军的人。』
label.en: Decline politely: 'I belong to General Guan.'

text.zh: 曹操笑笑：『都是一样的脾气。』当晚关羽请你喝了酒。
text.en: Cao smiles. 'The same temper, the pair of you.' That night Guan Yu buys you a drink.

label.en: Pretend not to understand.

text.zh: 曹操也不追问。
text.en: Cao doesn't press.

quote.zh: 公曰：「吾知此马日行千里，今幸得之，若知兄长下落，可一日而见面矣。」
quote.en: Guan Yu said: "I know this horse covers a thousand li a day. If I learn where my brother is, I can be with him in a single day."

text.zh: 关羽低声对你说：『你说过，他是要我欠他。欠下的，日后要还。』
text.en: Guan Yu says quietly to you, 'You told me he wants me in his debt. Debts have to be repaid.'

text.zh: 温芷约你在城南的药圃见面。她已经知道关羽在打听刘备的下落。『他总会走的，』她说，『你呢？』
text.en: Wen Zhi asks you to meet her at the herb garden south of the city. She knows Guan Yu has been asking where Liu Bei is. 'He'll leave sooner or later,' she says. 'And you?'

label.zh: 许诺：等天下稍定，回来接你。
label.en: Promise: when things settle, I'll come back for you.

text.zh: 她低头笑了一下，把一包止血散塞进你袖子里：『那你得活着回来。』
text.en: She looks down and smiles, and tucks a packet of wound powder into your sleeve. 'Then you'd better come back alive.'

label.zh: 实话实说：前路生死难料，不敢许诺。
label.en: Be honest: you can't promise anything when you might not survive.

text.zh: 『你倒老实。』她看着药圃，『老实人活得久些。』
text.en: 'You're honest, at least.' She looks out over the herbs. 'Honest people live longer.'

label.en: Ask her to come with you.

text.zh: 她摇头：『府里还有三个病人离不开我。』停了一下，她又说：『你问了，我记着。』
text.en: She shakes her head. 'Three patients there can't do without me.' A pause. 'But you asked. I'll remember that.'

text.zh: 『你托我听的那些话，』她说，『我还在听。』
text.en: 'The things you asked me to listen for,' she says, 'I'm still listening.'

text.zh: 白马一战，关羽斩了颜良，算是报了曹操的恩。不久，消息传来：刘备在袁绍军中。关羽把曹操所赠的金银封存在库，把汉寿亭侯印挂在堂上，就要走了。没有曹操的文书，沿途关隘不会放行。
text.en: At White Horse, Guan Yu kills Yan Liang and repays Cao Cao's kindness. Soon word comes: Liu Bei is with Yuan Shao. Guan Yu seals Cao's gold and silver in the storehouse, hangs his seal of office in the hall, and prepares to go. Without a pass from Cao, no checkpoint on the road will let him through.

text.zh: 曹操把你叫到一边：『云长要走，孤拦不住。你呢？』
text.en: Cao Cao draws you aside. 'Yunchang is leaving, and I can't stop him. And you?'

text.zh: 关羽临走前低声对你说：『那晚的话，别再对旁人说了。』
text.en: Before leaving, Guan Yu says quietly, 'What you said that night—don't say it to anyone else.'

label.zh: 随关羽护着两位夫人上路，一关一关闯过去。
label.en: Ride with Guan Yu and the ladies and force your way through, pass by pass.

text.zh: 一路过东岭、洛阳、汜水、荥阳、黄河渡口，关羽连斩六将。到古城与刘备重逢时，你的马已经换过三匹。
text.en: Through Dongling, Luoyang, Sishui, Xingyang and the Yellow River ford, Guan Yu kills six generals. By the time you reunite with Liu Bei at Gucheng, you've worn out three horses.

label.zh: 随关羽护着两位夫人上路，一关一关闯过去。
label.en: Ride with Guan Yu and the ladies and force your way through, pass by pass.

text.zh: 关羽把护送两位嫂嫂的车交给了你：『车在，人在。』
text.en: Guan Yu puts the ladies' carriage in your charge. 'As long as the carriage stands, so do you.'

text.zh: 一路过东岭、洛阳、汜水、荥阳、黄河渡口，关羽连斩六将。到古城与刘备重逢时，你的马已经换过三匹。
text.en: Through Dongling, Luoyang, Sishui, Xingyang and the Yellow River ford, Guan Yu kills six generals. By the time you reunite with Liu Bei at Gucheng, you've worn out three horses.

because.zh: 因为关羽敬重你，把车交给了你
because.en: Because Guan Yu respects you, he gives you the carriage

label.zh: 去求温芷，从丞相府弄一纸通关文书。
label.en: Ask Wen Zhi to get you a travel pass from the Chancellor's office.

text.zh: 温芷什么也没问，第二天就把盖了印的文书交给你。东岭关的孔秀验过文书，放你们过去了。到了洛阳，韩福不认这份文书，关羽的刀还是出了鞘。后来你听说，温芷为这件事被叫去问了三天话。
text.en: Wen Zhi asks nothing. The next day she hands you a stamped pass. At Dongling, Kong Xiu checks it and lets you through. At Luoyang, Han Fu refuses to honor it, and Guan Yu's blade comes out after all. Later you hear Wen Zhi was questioned for three days over it.

hint.zh: 需要温芷的信任在「观望」以上
hint.en: Needs Wen Zhi's trust at Watching or above

label.en: Stay, and serve Cao Cao as his adviser.

text.zh: 关羽在门口站了一会儿：『人各有志。保重。』他上马走了。当晚，曹操亲自给你斟了一杯酒。
text.en: Guan Yu stands in the doorway a while. 'Every man chooses his own road. Take care.' He mounts and rides away. That evening Cao Cao pours you a cup of wine himself.

hint.zh: 需要曹操的赏识在「寻常」以上，或已接受曹营官职
hint.en: Needs Cao's regard at Ordinary or above, or a post under Cao

text.zh: 曹操叹道：『土山上那三条，是子衡写的吧？我答应过，便不追了。』
text.en: Cao sighs. 'Those three terms on the hill—Ziheng wrote them, didn't he? I gave my word. I won't pursue.'

text.zh: 曹操把你叫到一边：『青梅亭上那个说话不留情的书生，我一直记得。留下来吧。』
text.en: Cao takes you aside. 'The scholar at the plum pavilion who spared no one—I haven't forgotten. Stay.'

text.zh: 曹操把你叫到一边：『那天打翻酒樽的，是你吧？好快的手。留下来吧。』
text.en: Cao takes you aside. 'It was you who knocked over that cup, wasn't it? Quick hands. Stay.'

text.zh: 关羽封金时对你说：『你说过他要我欠他。今天，能还的我都还了。』
text.en: As he seals the gold, Guan Yu says to you, 'You said he wanted me in his debt. Today I've repaid everything I can.'

text.zh: 关羽说：『土山上你劝我死战。今天，我总算可以走了。』
text.en: Guan Yu says, 'On the hill you told me to fight to the death. Today, at last, I can leave.'

text.zh: 你的主簿印信还放在案上。
text.en: Your clerk's seal of office is still lying on the desk.

text.zh: 关羽说：『那晚说过的，最怕负了大哥。今天该走了。』
text.en: Guan Yu says, 'I told you that night what I fear most. Today I have to go.'

means.zh: 劝曹操拦下、截杀关羽
means.en: urges Cao Cao to stop or kill Guan Yu before he leaves

text.zh: 曹操摆摆手：『各为其主，由他去吧。』关羽已经走到门口，回头看了你一眼。那一眼，你记了很多年。
text.en: Cao Cao waves it away. 'Each serves his own lord. Let him go.' Guan Yu, already at the door, looks back at you once. You remember that look for many years.

moves.match: 截杀|追杀|杀了?(他|关羽|云长)|别放(他|关羽)|不能放|拦住(他|关羽)|kill guan|stop (him|guan yu)|don't let him go

means.zh: 求关羽留下，别走
means.en: begs Guan Yu to stay with Cao Cao

text.zh: 关羽抚着长髯：『关某之心，你知道。』他把印绶的结又系紧了一些。
text.en: Guan Yu strokes his long beard. 'You know my heart.' He ties the cord of the seal a little tighter.

moves.match: 留下|别走|不要走|投(曹|丞相)|stay|don't go

text.zh: 消息传到冀州：关羽在白马斩了袁绍的大将颜良。袁绍大怒，要杀刘备。
text.en: News reaches Jizhou: at White Horse, Guan Yu has killed Yuan Shao's general Yan Liang. Yuan Shao is furious and wants Liu Bei dead.

label.zh: 献策：请主公向袁绍解释，再写信叫二弟来投。
label.en: Advise your lord to explain himself to Yuan Shao, then write to his brother to come.

text.zh: 袁绍信了，转怒为喜。刘备的信送到许都，关羽很快辞别曹操，一路过关斩将寻来。他见到你，说：『写信这一着，是你出的主意？』
text.en: Yuan Shao believes him and cheers up. The letter reaches Xuchang; Guan Yu soon takes leave of Cao and fights his way through the passes to find you. When he sees you he says, 'The letter—that was your idea?'

label.zh: 劝主公借口联络刘表，早日离开袁绍。
label.en: Advise him to leave Yuan Shao early, on the pretext of contacting Liu Biao.

text.zh: 刘备借故南下汝南，在古城与关羽、张飞重聚。袁绍不久便在官渡大败。
text.en: Liu Bei finds a reason to go south to Runan and reunites with Guan Yu and Zhang Fei at Gucheng. Not long after, Yuan Shao is crushed at Guandu.

label.zh: 站到主公身前，替他挡袁绍的怒气。
label.en: Step in front of your lord and take Yuan Shao's anger yourself.

text.zh: 袁绍的刀没有落下来。刘备什么也没说，只是那晚把自己的披风给了你。
text.en: Yuan Shao's sword doesn't fall. Liu Bei says nothing, but that night he gives you his cloak.

label.zh: 断言：袁绍必败，早走为上。
label.en: Declare it: Yuan Shao is doomed. Leave while you can.

text.zh: 刘备借故南下。不到一年，袁绍在官渡大败。刘备想起你那句话，后背发凉。
text.en: Liu Bei finds a reason to go south. Within the year Yuan Shao is crushed at Guandu. Liu Bei remembers what you said, and a chill runs down his back.

text.zh: 刘备握着你的手：『若不是你从下邳带出那句话，我还以为二弟死了。』
text.en: Liu Bei grips your hand. 'If you hadn't brought me word from Xiapi, I'd have thought my brother dead.'

text.zh: 刘备苦笑：『听说曹操至今还在打听，青梅亭上那个书生是谁。』
text.en: Liu Bei smiles ruefully. 'I hear Cao is still asking who that scholar at the plum pavilion was.'

text.zh: 一封信从许都辗转送到你手里，是温芷的字：『程昱仿徐母笔迹作书，将召徐元直北上。徐母本人不知。』第二天，徐庶就收到了『母亲』的信，哭着要走。
text.en: A letter reaches you by a roundabout route from Xuchang, in Wen Zhi's hand: 'Cheng Yu has forged a letter in Xu Shu's mother's handwriting to summon him north. She knows nothing of it.' The next day Xu Shu receives a letter from his 'mother' and, in tears, prepares to go.

label.en: Tell Xu Shu the truth.

text.zh: 徐庶拿着两封信对照了一夜，留下了。可他的母亲还在曹操手里，从那以后，他再没睡过一个整觉。
text.en: Xu Shu compares the two letters all night, and stays. But his mother is still in Cao's hands, and he never sleeps through the night again.

label.zh: 沉默。他的母亲在曹营，他留下也救不了她。
label.en: Say nothing. His mother is in Cao's hands; staying won't save her.

text.zh: 徐庶走了。出城十里，他又拨马回来，对刘备说：『此间有一奇士，只在襄阳城外二十里隆中。』说完再不回头。你一直看着他的背影。
text.en: Xu Shu leaves. Ten li out he turns his horse back and tells Liu Bei, 'There is a remarkable man nearby, at Longzhong, twenty li outside Xiangyang.' Then he rides off without looking back. You watch him until he's gone.

label.en: Tell your lord first and let him decide.

text.zh: 刘备想了很久：『母子天伦，我不能拦。』徐庶还是走了，临行前举荐了隆中的诸葛亮。刘备对你说：『你能先来问我，很好。』
text.en: Liu Bei thinks a long time. 'A son and his mother—I can't stand in the way.' Xu Shu leaves, recommending Zhuge Liang of Longzhong before he goes. Liu Bei tells you, 'It was right of you to come to me first.'

text.zh: 信末一行小字：『文书一事，问了三日，无妨。』
text.en: A line squeezed in at the bottom: 'About the pass—three days of questions. I'm fine.'

text.zh: 这一回，她不只是在听了。
text.en: This time she's done more than listen.

text.zh: 刘备带你去拜访隐士司马徽。水镜先生抚琴待客，谈到天下人才，只说了一句话。
text.en: Liu Bei takes you to call on the recluse Sima Hui. Master Water Mirror receives you with his zither, and when talk turns to talent, he says only one thing.

label.en: Press him: who is the Young Phoenix?

text.zh: 司马徽笑而不答。出门时，他的童子悄悄告诉你：『襄阳庞士元。』
text.en: Sima Hui only smiles. On your way out, his servant boy whispers, 'Pang Shiyuan of Xiangyang.'

label.en: Press him: where is the Sleeping Dragon?

text.zh: 司马徽只说：『好，好。』刘备一路上都在念叨这两个字。
text.en: Sima Hui says only, 'Good, good.' Liu Bei repeats it to himself the whole way home.

label.zh: 笑问：『先生看我算哪一种？』
label.en: Ask with a smile: 'And which kind am I?'

text.zh: 司马徽认真看了你一会儿：『你是记性好的那种。』刘备大笑。
text.en: Sima Hui studies you seriously. 'You're the kind with a good memory.' Liu Bei roars with laughter.

quote.zh: 徽曰：「伏龙、凤雏，两人得一，可安天下。」
quote.en: Sima Hui said: "Sleeping Dragon, Young Phoenix: win either one, and you can bring peace to the realm."

title.en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage

text.zh: 徐庶走马荐了诸葛亮。刘备冒着风雪去了隆中三次，前两次都扑了空。
text.en: Xu Shu, on his way out, recommended Zhuge Liang. Liu Bei goes to Longzhong three times through wind and snow; the first two times he finds no one home.

text.zh: 徐庶留了下来。少了那一场离别，就没有人在城外回马举荐什么人。刘备只记得水镜先生那句『卧龙、凤雏』。
text.en: Xu Shu has stayed. Without that farewell, no one turns back at the gate to recommend anyone. All Liu Bei has is Master Water Mirror's riddle about a dragon and a phoenix.

text.zh: 到了草堂外，刘备让关羽、张飞在柴门外等，只带你一个人进去。
text.en: At the thatched cottage Liu Bei leaves Guan Yu and Zhang Fei at the gate and takes only you inside.

text.zh: 到了草堂外，刘备让你在柴门外牵马。
text.en: At the thatched cottage Liu Bei leaves you at the gate to hold the horses.

text.zh: 刘备待你仍旧客气，只是议事时，他不再先问你。
text.en: Liu Bei is as courteous as ever—but at council, he no longer asks you first.

text.zh: 刘备笑着对诸葛亮说：『子衡这人，什么话都敢说。』你分不清这是夸你还是提醒你。
text.en: Liu Bei says to Zhuge Liang with a smile, 'Ziheng will say anything.' You can't tell whether it's praise or a warning.

label.zh: 陪主公三顾，第三次在门外站着等他睡醒。
label.en: Go with your lord all three times, and the third time stand outside until the man wakes.

text.zh: 诸葛亮终于出来，为刘备画了一张天下的图：『将军欲成霸业，北让曹操占天时，南让孙权占地利，将军可占人和。』出门时，他特意向你拱了拱手。
text.en: Zhuge Liang finally comes out and draws Liu Bei a map of the realm: 'If you would build an empire, let Cao Cao have the moment in the north and Sun Quan the land in the south; you can have the people.' On the way out he makes a point of bowing to you.

label.zh: 和徐庶一起，向主公举荐隆中的诸葛亮。
label.en: Join Xu Shu in recommending Zhuge Liang of Longzhong to your lord.

text.zh: 刘备三顾隆中。诸葛亮出山时说：『元直举荐，子衡作陪，亮岂敢不来？』隆中对那张图，你们三个人一起看的。
text.en: Liu Bei makes his three visits. When Zhuge Liang agrees to come, he says, 'Recommended by Yuanzhi, escorted by Ziheng—how could I refuse?' The three of you study his map together.

label.zh: 同时举荐庞统：卧龙、凤雏，为何不能两个都要？
label.en: Recommend Pang Tong as well: why not have both the dragon and the phoenix?

text.zh: 刘备三顾隆中，请出了诸葛亮；又派人去襄阳，庞统竟也来了。他长得丑，话却说得漂亮。诸葛亮笑道：『子衡这一手，比我快了好几年。』
text.en: Liu Bei makes his three visits and wins Zhuge Liang; he also sends to Xiangyang, and Pang Tong comes too. He's ugly, but he talks beautifully. Zhuge Liang laughs. 'Ziheng's move is several years ahead of mine.'

hint.zh: 需要知道凤雏是谁
hint.en: Needs to know who the Young Phoenix is

label.zh: 站在一边冷眼看着：这个年轻人一来，你的位置就没了。
label.en: Stand aside and watch coldly: once this young man arrives, your place is gone.

text.zh: 刘备自己去了隆中三次。
text.en: Liu Bei goes to Longzhong three times on his own.

text.zh: 诸葛亮出山了。他待你客气，客气得让你发冷。有一晚刘备问你：『子衡近来话少了？』
text.en: Zhuge Liang comes. He is polite to you—so polite it chills you. One night Liu Bei asks, 'You've been quiet lately, Ziheng?'

label.zh: 抢在诸葛亮开口之前，把三分天下的大势先说给主公听。
label.en: Before Zhuge Liang can speak, lay out the three-way division of the realm for your lord yourself.

text.zh: 刘备听得出神。诸葛亮出来时，你已经说完了。他看了你一眼，把准备好的地图又卷了起来，只说：『子衡兄所言，正是亮之所想。』
text.en: Liu Bei listens spellbound. By the time Zhuge Liang comes out, you've finished. He glances at you, rolls his prepared map back up, and says only, 'Ziheng has said exactly what I was thinking.'

quote.zh: 孔明曰：「……将军欲成霸业，北让曹操占天时，南让孙权占地利，将军可占人和。」
quote.en: Zhuge Liang said: "…If you would build an empire, let Cao Cao have the moment in the north and Sun Quan the land in the south; you can have the people."

text.zh: 风雪里，刘备忽然说：『许都那杯酒，我一直记得。先生胆大心细，今天也帮我看看这个人。』
text.en: In the snow Liu Bei suddenly says, 'I've never forgotten that cup of wine in Xuchang. You're bold and careful. Help me judge this man today.'

text.zh: 徐庶走在你身边，低声说：『我母亲的事……多谢。』
text.en: Xu Shu walks beside you and says quietly, 'About my mother… thank you.'

text.zh: 刘备说：『当年你从下邳带来那一句话，我就知道，你是能托付的人。』
text.en: Liu Bei says, 'When you brought me that message from Xiapi, I knew you were someone I could rely on.'

text.zh: 刘备问起：『听说云长过关时有一纸文书，是哪位贵人？』你没有说出她的名字。
text.en: Liu Bei asks, 'I hear Yunchang had a pass at the checkpoints. Who was the benefactor?' You don't say her name.

q.zh: 诸葛亮请刘备入内，却先看向你：『子衡兄在门外站了半日。亮想先问一句——刘使君凭什么取天下？』
q.en: Zhuge Liang invites Liu Bei in, but looks at you first. 'You stood outside half the day, Ziheng. Let me ask you first: what will Lord Liu take the realm with?'

means.zh: 地利：荆州、益州、据险而守、三分天下
means.en: territory: Jingzhou, Yizhou, a three-way split

text.zh: 诸葛亮手里的扇子停了。他看了你很久：『这张图，亮画了十年，还没给人看过。子衡兄从哪里看来的？』
text.en: Zhuge Liang's fan stops. He looks at you a long time. 'I've drawn that map for ten years and shown it to no one. Where did you see it, Ziheng?'

answers.match: 荆州|益州|西川|两川|巴蜀|汉中|三分|鼎足|jingzhou|yizhou|shu|three ways|tripod

means.zh: 说取不了天下、没有机会
means.en: says he can't

text.zh: 刘备的脸色变了。诸葛亮却笑了：『肯说真话的人不多。那亮就来试试，看能不能让子衡兄改口。』
text.en: Liu Bei's face changes. Zhuge Liang laughs. 'Few men will tell the truth. Then let me try to make you change your mind.'

answers.match: 取不了|不能|没机会|没有机会|难|不行|can't|cannot|no chance|impossible

means.zh: 天命、汉室宗亲、皇叔的名分
means.en: Heaven's mandate, his imperial blood

text.zh: 诸葛亮淡淡一笑：『天命，是说给别人听的。子衡兄自己信吗？』
text.en: Zhuge Liang smiles faintly. 'Heaven's mandate is something you tell other people. Do you believe it yourself?'

answers.match: 天命|天意|宗亲|皇叔|汉室|正统|血脉|mandate|heaven|imperial|bloodline

means.zh: 仁义、人心、百姓
means.en: benevolence, people's hearts

text.zh: 诸葛亮点头：『人和。曹操有天时，孙权有地利，使君能有的，只有这个。』刘备在旁边听着，没有说话。
text.en: Zhuge Liang nods. 'The people. Cao has the moment, Sun Quan has the land; this is all my lord can have.' Liu Bei listens and says nothing.

answers.match: 仁|义|人心|民心|百姓|人和|benevol|righteous|the people|hearts

means.zh: 人才、得人、请到诸葛亮这样的人
means.en: talent, winning men like Zhuge

text.zh: 诸葛亮笑了：『这一句，亮听出来了，是在夸亮。』他摇着扇子，却没有否认。
text.en: Zhuge Liang smiles. 'I can hear that one is meant for me.' He fans himself, but doesn't deny it.

answers.match: 人才|得人|贤|先生|孔明|卧龙|talent|able men|kongming

means.zh: 推辞、不正面回答
means.en: evades

text.zh: 诸葛亮也不追问：『那就听亮说吧。』
text.en: Zhuge Liang doesn't press. 'Then hear what I have to say.'

answers.match: 不知|不敢|先生说|请先生|i don't know|you tell

means.zh: 抢在诸葛亮之前说出三分天下的大势（取荆州、益州，联合东吴）
means.en: lays out the three-way division before Zhuge Liang can (take Jing and Yi, ally with Wu)

text.zh: 诸葛亮手里的扇子停了。他看了你很久，才笑着对刘备说：『主公帐下有此人，何必三顾亮的草庐？』笑意没到眼底。
text.en: The fan in Zhuge Liang's hand stops. He looks at you a long time before smiling at Liu Bei. 'With such a man in your service, my lord, why come three times to my cottage?' The smile doesn't reach his eyes.

moves.match: 三分|荆州.{0,8}益州|益州.{0,8}荆州|联(吴|孙)|three kingdoms|divide the realm|jingzhou.{0,20}yizhou

text.zh: 春天，温芷在药圃里晒药，你帮她翻竹匾。这样的日子已经过了好几年，你们谁都没有说破。
text.en: Spring. Wen Zhi is drying herbs in the garden, and you help turn the trays. You've had years of days like this, and neither of you has said anything.

label.en: Say it.

text.zh: 她把一片当归放进你手心：『这个，叫当归。』她没再说别的，你也懂了。
text.en: She puts a slice of angelica root in your palm. 'This is called danggui—"you should come home."' She says nothing more, and you understand.

label.zh: 再等等，等天下定了再说。
label.en: Wait a little longer—until the realm is settled.

text.zh: 她点点头，像是早就知道你会这么说。
text.en: She nods, as if she knew you'd say that.

label.zh: 问她：丞相府里，谁最不喜欢你？
label.en: Ask her: who in the Chancellor's household likes you least?

text.zh: 『程昱，』她说，『他说你骨子里还是刘备的人。』
text.en: 'Cheng Yu,' she says. 'He says that deep down you still belong to Liu Bei.'

text.zh: 程昱来找你：刘备得了个军师徐庶，屡次坏丞相的事。徐庶是孝子，他母亲就在许都。『你写得一手好字，』程昱说，『仿一封徐母的家书，不难吧？』
text.en: Cheng Yu comes to see you. Liu Bei has a new strategist, Xu Shu, who keeps spoiling the Chancellor's plans. Xu Shu is a devoted son, and his mother is in Xuchang. 'You write a fine hand,' Cheng Yu says. 'Forging a letter from his mother shouldn't be hard.'

text.zh: 程昱压低了声音：『丞相点名要你写。他说，这种事只信得过你。』
text.en: Cheng Yu lowers his voice. 'The Chancellor asked for you by name. He says this is the kind of thing he trusts only you with.'

label.en: Write it. These are the Chancellor's orders.

text.zh: 信写得很像。徐庶果然来了许都，见到母亲才知道是假信。徐母大骂儿子糊涂，当晚自缢。你在灵前站了很久。
text.en: The letter is a good likeness. Xu Shu comes to Xuchang and learns from his mother that it was forged. She rebukes him for a fool and hangs herself that night. You stand before her coffin a long time.

label.en: Claim an injured hand and beg off.

text.zh: 程昱自己写了。徐庶照样来了，徐母照样死了。程昱从此不太和你说话。
text.en: Cheng Yu writes it himself. Xu Shu comes all the same, and his mother dies all the same. Cheng Yu barely speaks to you after that.

label.zh: 表面答应，暗中托人给新野送信，揭穿此事。
label.en: Agree to his face, then secretly send word to Xinye exposing the plot.

text.zh: 信写了，可徐庶没有来。程昱查了半个月，没有查到你。徐母活了下来，被软禁在许都。
text.en: The letter is written, but Xu Shu doesn't come. Cheng Yu investigates for half a month and never finds you. Xu Shu's mother lives, under guard in Xuchang.

text.zh: 后来听说，刘备还是去隆中请出了诸葛亮——是水镜先生指的路。
text.en: Later you hear Liu Bei went to Longzhong and won Zhuge Liang anyway—Master Water Mirror pointed the way.

text.zh: 程昱补了一句：『丞相说，青梅亭上就看出你这人心思多。』
text.en: Cheng Yu adds, 'The Chancellor says he saw at the plum pavilion how many thoughts you keep.'

text.zh: 程昱说：『丞相还记得你那天打翻的酒樽。他说你手快，心更快。』
text.en: Cheng Yu says, 'The Chancellor still remembers the cup you knocked over. He says your hands are quick and your mind quicker.'

text.zh: 程昱说：『主簿大人，丞相府的笔，你用了七年了。』
text.en: Cheng Yu says, 'Master Clerk, you've held the Chancellor's brush for seven years now.'

text.zh: 刘备摆手打断你：『这时候，不必说好听的。』
text.en: Liu Bei waves you silent. 'This is no time for pretty words.'

text.zh: 当阳长坂，曹军追到了。百姓哭喊着四散，刘备的家眷在乱军中走散了。
text.en: Changban, near Dangyang. Cao's cavalry catches up. Civilians scatter, screaming, and Liu Bei's family is lost in the chaos.

text.zh: 乱军里，刘备一把拉住你的缰绳：『子衡，你说怎么办，我听你的。』
text.en: In the chaos Liu Bei grabs your reins. 'Ziheng, tell me what to do. I'll listen.'

text.zh: 刘备身边围满了人，你挤不进去说话。
text.en: Liu Bei is surrounded; you can't get close enough to speak.

label.zh: 劝主公扔下百姓，轻骑快走。
label.en: Urge your lord to leave the civilians and ride for it.

text.zh: 刘备红着眼睛：『举大事者必以人为本。今人归我，奈何弃之？』他没听你的。身边几个将领看你的眼神变了。
text.en: Liu Bei's eyes are red. 'Great undertakings rest on the people. They have come to me—how can I abandon them?' He doesn't take your advice. Several of his officers look at you differently after that.

label.zh: 跟赵云一起杀回去，找夫人和小公子。
label.en: Ride back in with Zhao Yun to find the lady and the young heir.

text.zh: 你们在一堵断墙后找到了糜夫人，她腿上中了枪，怀里抱着阿斗。赵云接过孩子，你扶夫人上了你的马。赵云单骑在前，怀抱阿斗冲出重围；你带着夫人从小路绕出来，左肩挨了一箭。
text.en: Behind a broken wall you find Lady Mi, a spear wound in her leg, the infant Adou in her arms. Zhao Yun takes the child; you lift the lady onto your horse. Zhao Yun rides out alone through the encirclement with Adou at his chest, while you take the lady out by a back path and catch an arrow in your left shoulder.

hint.zh: 需要刘备的信任在「可托」以上，他才会把家眷托给你
hint.en: Needs Liu Bei's trust at Reliable or above to entrust his family to you

label.zh: 跟赵云一起杀回去，找夫人和小公子。
label.en: Ride back in with Zhao Yun to find the lady and the young heir.

text.zh: 你们在一堵断墙后找到了糜夫人，她腿上中了枪，怀里抱着阿斗。赵云接过孩子，你扶夫人上了你的马。赵云单骑在前，怀抱阿斗冲出重围；你带着夫人从小路绕出来，左肩挨了一箭。你撕开温芷的药囊，按在伤口上，血止住了。
text.en: Behind a broken wall you find Lady Mi, a spear wound in her leg, the infant Adou in her arms. Zhao Yun takes the child; you lift the lady onto your horse. Zhao Yun rides out alone with Adou at his chest, while you take the lady out by a back path and catch an arrow in your left shoulder. You tear open Wen Zhi's pouch and press it to the wound, and the bleeding stops.

hint.zh: 需要刘备的信任在「可托」以上，他才会把家眷托给你
hint.en: Needs Liu Bei's trust at Reliable or above to entrust his family to you

because.zh: 因为温芷给过你那个药囊
because.en: Because Wen Zhi gave you that pouch

label.zh: 献策：让张飞在长坂桥东的树林里拖着树枝跑马，扬尘作疑兵。
label.en: Suggest Zhang Fei have riders drag branches through the woods east of the bridge to raise dust and fake an army.

text.zh: 刘备犹豫了半刻才点头。张飞还是吼退了曹军，可桥西的百姓，没能全过来。
text.en: Liu Bei hesitates a moment before he nods. Zhang Fei still roars Cao's army back, but not all the people west of the bridge make it across.

because.zh: 因为刘备还不够信你，耽误了半刻
because.en: Because Liu Bei doesn't trust you enough yet, a moment is lost

label.zh: 献策：让张飞在长坂桥东的树林里拖着树枝跑马，扬尘作疑兵。
label.en: Suggest Zhang Fei have riders drag branches through the woods east of the bridge to raise dust and fake an army.

text.zh: 刘备一点头，张飞就去了。
text.en: Liu Bei nods, and Zhang Fei is already gone.

text.zh: 张飞横矛立马桥上，大喝一声：『我乃燕人张翼德也！谁敢与我决一死战？』身后林中尘土大起。曹军疑有伏兵，竟不敢过桥。
text.en: Zhang Fei plants himself on the bridge with his spear across his saddle and roars, 'I am Zhang Yide of Yan! Who dares fight me to the death?' Behind him dust boils up from the woods. Suspecting an ambush, Cao's army won't cross.

because.zh: 因为刘备信你，你的话当场就用上了
because.en: Because Liu Bei trusts you, your plan is used on the spot

label.zh: 预先劝主公：让赵云专护家眷，寸步不离。
label.en: Warn your lord in advance: have Zhao Yun guard his family and never leave their side.

text.zh: 刘备依了你。乱军中家眷还是被冲散了，赵云单骑杀回去，把阿斗抱了出来；糜夫人离得近，被你扶上了马。
text.en: Liu Bei takes your advice. The family is still scattered in the rout; Zhao Yun rides back alone and carries Adou out; Lady Mi was close by, and you get her onto your horse.

text.zh: 诸葛亮在乱军里喊你的名字，让你护着百姓先走。他的声音很稳，你却没有回头。
text.en: Through the chaos Zhuge Liang calls your name, telling you to get the civilians moving. His voice is steady; you don't look back.

text.zh: 你想起古城楼上他说的：我从没扔下过他们。
text.en: You remember what he said on the Gucheng wall: I've never left them behind.

text.zh: 长坂坡上，一员白袍将抱着婴孩，在你们的阵里杀进杀出，所向披靡。曹操在山顶看着，问：『那是谁？』
text.en: On the slope at Changban, a general in a white robe with an infant strapped to his chest cuts through your lines again and again. From the hilltop Cao Cao asks, 'Who is that?'

text.zh: 曹操把你叫到身边一起看：『子衡，你看此人如何？』
text.en: Cao Cao calls you to his side to watch. 'Ziheng, what do you make of him?'

label.zh: 答：『常山赵子龙。此人只可活捉，不可射杀。』
label.en: Answer: 'Zhao Zilong of Changshan. Take him alive; don't shoot him.'

text.zh: 曹操点头，急令传报：『如赵云到，不许放冷箭，只要捉活的。』赵云就这样一路杀了出去。曹操望着他的背影：『好一员将。』
text.en: Cao nods and sends word down the lines: 'If Zhao Yun comes your way, no arrows—take him alive.' And so Zhao Yun fights his way out. Cao watches him go. 'What a general.'

label.zh: 劝曹操下令放箭：这一个人能抵一支军队。
label.en: Urge Cao to order the archers to shoot: this one man is worth an army.

text.zh: 曹操犹豫了一下：『这样的人，杀了可惜。』他还是下令捉活的。赵云冲了出去。曹操看了你一眼，没说什么。
text.en: Cao hesitates. 'A man like that—it would be a waste to kill him.' He orders him taken alive. Zhao Yun breaks out. Cao glances at you and says nothing.

label.zh: 借口查看后军，悄悄让开一条路，放刘备的家眷过去。
label.en: Make an excuse to inspect the rear and quietly open a gap for Liu Bei's people.

text.zh: 几辆车从你让开的缺口里逃了出去。没有人看见——你希望没有人看见。
text.en: A few carts escape through the gap you've opened. No one saw—you hope no one saw.

label.zh: 借口查看后军，悄悄让开一条路，放刘备的家眷过去。
label.en: Make an excuse to inspect the rear and quietly open a gap for Liu Bei's people.

text.zh: 几辆车从你让开的缺口里逃了出去。当天夜里，程昱的人把这件事报了上去。曹操没有找你，只是第二天把你的差事交给了别人。
text.en: A few carts escape through the gap you've opened. That night Cheng Yu's man reports it. Cao Cao doesn't summon you—he just gives your duties to someone else the next day.

because.zh: 因为程昱的人一直盯着你
because.en: Because Cheng Yu's man has been watching you

quote.zh: （曹操传令各处）「如赵云到，不许放冷箭，只要捉活的。」
quote.en: (Cao Cao's order to every unit) "If Zhao Yun comes, no stray arrows. Take him alive."

text.zh: 你想起徐庶。他也在刘备的队伍里吗？
text.en: You think of Xu Shu. Is he in Liu Bei's column too?

text.zh: 远处是刘备的旗号。七年前，你本该在那面旗下面。
text.en: In the distance fly Liu Bei's banners. Seven years ago you would have been under them.

text.zh: 周瑜要诸葛亮十天造十万支箭，诸葛亮说三天就够。第三天夜里，大雾漫江，他请鲁肃和你上船喝酒。
text.en: Zhou Yu demands a hundred thousand arrows in ten days; Zhuge Liang says three days will do. On the third night thick fog covers the river, and he invites Lu Su and you aboard to drink.

label.zh: 陪他饮酒，听北岸箭如雨下。
label.en: Drink with him and listen to the arrows rain down from the north bank.

text.zh: 二十条草船靠近曹营擂鼓呐喊。曹军不敢出战，只管放箭。天亮收船，船两边插满了箭。诸葛亮举杯：『子衡今夜不慌，难得。』
text.en: Twenty straw-lined boats close on Cao's camp with drums and shouting. Cao's men won't come out; they just shoot. At dawn the boats pull back bristling with arrows. Zhuge Liang raises his cup. 'You kept calm tonight, Ziheng. That's rare.'

label.zh: 先把计策悄悄告诉鲁肃，免得他吓坏。
label.en: Quietly explain the plan to Lu Su first, so he doesn't panic.

text.zh: 鲁肃松了一口气，转身却把话告诉了周瑜。周瑜对诸葛亮更加忌惮。诸葛亮看你的眼神多了一分探究：『这条计，我对谁都没说过。』
text.en: Lu Su is relieved—and then tells Zhou Yu, who grows warier still of Zhuge Liang. Zhuge Liang studies you more closely. 'I never told anyone this plan.'

text.zh: 这封信写得很短。上回你那些话，她大概还没消气。
text.en: The letter is short. She probably hasn't forgiven what you said last time.

text.zh: 一封信穿过两军的封锁送到你手里：温芷随曹军南下了，在乌林后营给病兵配药。信里说北兵晕船，丞相在想办法让船稳下来。末尾一句：『江上风大，你多穿些。』
text.en: A letter slips through both armies' lines to you: Wen Zhi has come south with Cao's army and is mixing medicine for the sick at the rear camp at Wulin. Northern soldiers are seasick, she writes, and the Chancellor is looking for a way to steady the boats. The last line: 'It's windy on the river. Dress warmly.'

label.zh: 回信：『冬至以后，离开水寨，越远越好。』
label.en: Write back: 'After the solstice, get away from the river camp. As far as you can.'

text.zh: 你没法解释为什么。回信只有一个字：『好。』
text.en: You can't explain why. Her reply is a single word: 'Yes.'

label.zh: 回信请她多写些曹营的事。
label.en: Write back asking her to tell you more about Cao's camp.

text.zh: 她又写来两封，第三封没有来。你把信里的消息交给了诸葛亮，他说很有用。
text.en: She writes twice more; the third letter never comes. You pass what she wrote to Zhuge Liang, who says it's very useful.

label.en: Write back just: 'You too.'

text.zh: 信送出去了。你不知道她能不能收到。
text.en: The letter goes out. You don't know if it will reach her.

text.zh: 你想起药圃里那包止血散，到现在还没用完。
text.en: You think of the wound powder from the herb garden. You still haven't used it all.

text.zh: 她说过只听不偷。这一封，她什么都没偷，只是在担心你。
text.en: She said she'd listen, not steal. This letter steals nothing. She's just worried about you.

text.zh: 诸葛亮和周瑜都定了火攻。问题是：曹操的船分散着，一把火烧不了几条。得有人让曹操自己把船连起来。原本该做这件事的人，现在坐在你对面喝茶——庞统。
text.en: Zhuge Liang and Zhou Yu have both settled on fire. The trouble is that Cao's ships are spread out; one fire won't catch many. Someone has to get Cao to chain them together himself. The man who should have done it is sitting across from you, drinking tea: Pang Tong.

label.zh: 请庞统诈投曹营，献连环计。
label.en: Ask Pang Tong to defect to Cao in pretense and offer the chain plan.

text.zh: 庞统笑道：『我本来就想去看看曹孟德。』几天后，曹营的大船三十一排、五十一排，用铁环连在了一起。
text.en: Pang Tong laughs. 'I've been wanting a look at Cao Mengde anyway.' A few days later Cao's big ships are linked in rows of thirty and fifty with iron rings.

label.zh: 不必派人：北兵晕船，曹操自己会想到把船连起来。
label.en: No need to send anyone: his northerners are seasick. Cao will think of chaining the ships himself.

text.zh: 诸葛亮看了你很久：『你怎么知道？』十天后探马来报：曹操听了蔡瑁的建议，用铁环把大船连在了一起。庞统留在了刘备身边。
text.en: Zhuge Liang looks at you a long time. 'How would you know?' Ten days later scouts report that, on Cai Mao's advice, Cao has chained his big ships together. Pang Tong stays with Liu Bei.

label.zh: 你自己过江，去曹营献这条计。
label.en: Cross the river yourself and offer Cao the plan.

text.zh: 你在曹营待了五天，曹操听你讲连船之妙，抚掌大笑。离开那天，你在后营门口远远看见一个背药箱的身影。
text.en: You spend five days in Cao's camp. Cao listens to you explain the virtues of chained ships and claps with delight. On the day you leave, you glimpse from the rear gate a distant figure carrying a medicine chest.

hint.zh: 需要伤已痊愈
hint.en: Needs your wound to have healed

text.zh: 庞统放下茶杯：『是你把我早拉进来的。这件事，你说怎么办？』
text.en: Pang Tong sets down his cup. 'You brought me in early. So—what do we do about this?'

text.zh: 十一月二十日，东南风起。黄盖的二十条火船直冲曹营，连在一起的战船一条接一条烧起来。江面红了半边天。
text.en: The twentieth day of the eleventh month: the southeast wind rises. Huang Gai's twenty fire ships ram straight into Cao's fleet, and the chained warships catch one after another. Half the sky over the river turns red.

text.zh: 诸葛亮把令旗分给众将，最后一面递到你手里：『子衡兄，这一面，你看着用。』
text.en: Zhuge Liang hands out the command flags to the generals and puts the last one in your hand. 'Brother Ziheng—use this one as you see fit.'

label.zh: 趁乱驾一条小船，去乌林后营接温芷。
label.en: Take a small boat in the chaos and go to the rear camp at Wulin for Wen Zhi.

text.zh: 乌林后营已经空了一半。你在江边找到她时，她正背着药箱等船。『我就知道你会来，』她说，『你信里那个字写得太急。』
text.en: The rear camp at Wulin is half empty already. When you find her on the bank she's waiting for a boat with her medicine chest. 'I knew you'd come,' she says. 'Your handwriting in that letter was too rushed.'

text.zh: 后营已经烧起来了。你在烟里喊她的名字，嗓子都喊哑了，最后在江边一条破船底下找到她。她的手烧伤了，还抱着药箱。
text.en: The rear camp is already burning. You shout her name through the smoke until your voice gives out, and finally find her under a wrecked boat on the bank, her hands burned, still clutching her medicine chest.

text.zh: 回到南岸时，仗已经打完了。刘备问你去了哪里，你没有回答。
text.en: By the time you're back on the south bank, the battle is over. Liu Bei asks where you went. You don't answer.

hint.zh: 需要与温芷足够亲近
hint.en: Needs to be close enough to Wen Zhi

label.zh: 留在诸葛亮身边，帮他调度追击的伏兵。
label.en: Stay with Zhuge Liang and help him deploy the ambushes.

text.zh: 诸葛亮一道一道发令：赵云去乌林，张飞去葫芦口……最后才看向关羽。
text.en: Zhuge Liang gives his orders one by one: Zhao Yun to Wulin, Zhang Fei to Hulu Pass… and only at the end does he look at Guan Yu.

hint.zh: 需要诸葛亮的敬重在「寻常」以上
hint.en: Needs Zhuge Liang's respect at Ordinary or above

label.en: Stand on the south bank and watch the fire.

text.zh: 火烧了一夜。你知道史书会怎么写这一夜，但亲眼看见，还是不一样。
text.en: It burns all night. You know how the histories will tell it, but seeing it is different.

text.zh: 庞统站在你旁边看着火光：『这把火，有我一分。』
text.en: Pang Tong stands beside you watching the flames. 'Part of this fire is mine.'

text.zh: 你望着乌林的方向。她走了没有？
text.en: You look toward Wulin. Did she get out?

text.zh: 糜夫人派人送来一件夹袄，说是给子衡挡江风。
text.en: Lady Mi sends over a padded jacket—'to keep the river wind off Ziheng.'

text.zh: 徐庶站在船头，脸被火光照得通红：『我娘还在北边。』
text.en: Xu Shu stands at the bow, his face red in the firelight. 'My mother is still in the north.'

text.zh: 庞统看着火光：『这把火没用上我。也好。』
text.en: Pang Tong watches the flames. 'This fire didn't need me. Just as well.'

text.zh: 你摸了摸袖子里那包止血散。乌林就在火的那一边。
text.en: You feel the packet of wound powder in your sleeve. Wulin is on the other side of the fire.

text.zh: 你想起那封没有来的第三封信。
text.en: You think of the third letter that never came.

text.zh: 你没顾上庞统的事。好在北兵晕船，蔡瑁出了主意，曹操自己用铁环把船连了起来。
text.en: You never dealt with the Pang Tong question. As luck would have it, the northerners were seasick, Cai Mao made a suggestion, and Cao chained his ships together himself.

text.zh: 庞统来献连环计：用铁环把大船连起来，北兵就不晕了。曹操大喜，众谋士都说好，只有程昱开口。
text.en: Pang Tong offers his chain plan: link the big ships with iron rings and the northern soldiers will stop being sick. Cao Cao is delighted and his advisers all agree. Only Cheng Yu speaks up.

text.zh: 曹操转过头来：『子衡，你也说说。』
text.en: Cao Cao turns to you. 'Ziheng—your view?'

text.zh: 曹操摆摆手：『你的好话我听腻了，今天说点有用的。』
text.en: Cao waves a hand. 'I'm tired of your compliments. Say something useful today.'

text.zh: 曹操扫了你一眼：『今天倒是安静。』
text.en: Cao glances at you. 'Quiet today, aren't we.'

label.zh: 附和程昱：『冬至前后，常有东南风。』
label.en: Back Cheng Yu: 'Around the solstice there's often a southeast wind.'

text.zh: 曹操笑了：『你也学程仲德？』但他还是准你留下二十条船不连锁，泊在下游。
text.en: Cao laughs. 'Now you're imitating Cheng Zhongde?' But he lets you keep twenty ships unchained, moored downstream.

label.zh: 附和丞相：北兵能站稳，比什么都要紧。
label.en: Back the Chancellor: getting the northerners on their feet matters more than anything.

text.zh: 曹操很高兴，赏了你一匹马。
text.en: Cao is pleased and gives you a horse.

label.zh: 什么也不说，回营让温芷把病兵和药都搬到岸上。
label.en: Say nothing. Go back and tell Wen Zhi to move the sick and the medicine ashore.

text.zh: 温芷看着你：『你知道什么？』你说：『什么都不知道。搬吧。』
text.en: Wen Zhi looks at you. 'What do you know?' 'Nothing,' you say. 'Just move them.'

hint.zh: 需要与温芷足够亲近
hint.en: Needs to be close enough to Wen Zhi

quote.zh: 程昱曰：「船皆连锁，固是平稳；但彼若用火攻，难以回避。不可不防。」……操曰：「凡用火攻，必藉风力。方今隆冬之际，但有西风北风，安有东风南风耶？」
quote.en: Cheng Yu said: "Chained ships are steady, yes—but if they use fire we'll have no escape. We must guard against it." … Cao replied: "Fire depends on the wind. In the depth of winter there is only west wind and north wind. Where would an east or south wind come from?"

text.zh: 庞统经过你身边，低声说：『徐元直托我问候你。』你的手抖了一下。
text.en: Passing you, Pang Tong murmurs, 'Xu Yuanzhi sends his regards.' Your hand trembles.

text.zh: 温芷把一片当归塞进你衣襟：『记得回家。』
text.en: Wen Zhi tucks a slice of angelica into your collar. 'Remember to come home.'

text.zh: 曹操瞥了你一眼：『东南风？』他笑了，没有再说。
text.en: Cao glances at you. 'A southeast wind?' He laughs and says no more.

text.zh: 诸葛亮派关羽去守华容道。关羽当众立下军令状：若放走曹操，愿依军法。散帐后，刘备低声说：『吾弟义气深重，若曹操果然投华容道去时，只恐端的放了。』
text.en: Zhuge Liang sends Guan Yu to hold the Huarong road, and Guan Yu swears before everyone to forfeit his life if Cao escapes. Afterwards Liu Bei says quietly, 'My brother has a deep sense of honor. If Cao really comes by Huarong, I fear he'll let him go.'

text.zh: 关羽出帐前，在你肩上拍了一下，什么也没说。
text.en: On his way out of the tent Guan Yu claps you on the shoulder and says nothing.

text.zh: 诸葛亮摇着扇子：『子衡兄的好话，亮已经攒了一箩筐。今天，说句实话吧。』
text.en: Zhuge Liang waves his fan. 'I've a basketful of your compliments already, Ziheng. Today, tell me something true.'

text.zh: 诸葛亮咳了一声，故意不看你。那晚灯下的话，他显然还记得。
text.en: Zhuge Liang clears his throat and pointedly doesn't look at you. He clearly remembers what you said that night by the lamp.

text.zh: 诸葛亮对你客气得过了头。灯下那句冲撞，他没有提，也没有忘。
text.en: Zhuge Liang is excessively polite to you. He hasn't mentioned what you threw at him by the lamp—nor forgotten it.

label.zh: 替关羽作保：若他放了曹操，你与他同罪。
label.en: Vouch for Guan Yu: if he lets Cao go, you share his punishment.

text.zh: 关羽在华容道等到了曹操。曹操只剩三百多骑，人人带伤。他提起当年的恩情，关羽长叹一声，把马头拨开了。
text.en: Guan Yu waits on the Huarong road, and Cao comes—three hundred riders left, every one of them wounded. Cao speaks of old kindnesses. Guan Yu sighs and turns his horse aside.

text.zh: 回营后诸葛亮要斩关羽，你跪在关羽身边。刘备求情，诸葛亮便收了令。关羽扶你起来的时候，手很重。
text.en: Back in camp Zhuge Liang orders Guan Yu executed, and you kneel beside him. Liu Bei pleads, and Zhuge Liang withdraws the order. When Guan Yu helps you up, his grip is heavy.

hint.zh: 需要关羽的敬重在「器重」以上，或刘备的信任在「倚重」以上，且关羽没有被你冒犯过两次以上
hint.en: Needs Guan Yu's respect at Valued or above, or Liu Bei's trust at Relied on or above, and not to have offended Guan Yu twice

label.zh: 把那卷《春秋》还给关羽：『将军，书还你。我替你作保。』
label.en: Give Guan Yu back his Annals: 'Your book, General. I'll vouch for you.'

text.zh: 关羽在华容道等到了曹操。曹操只剩三百多骑，人人带伤。他提起当年的恩情，关羽长叹一声，把马头拨开了。
text.en: Guan Yu waits on the Huarong road, and Cao comes—three hundred riders left, every one of them wounded. Cao speaks of old kindnesses. Guan Yu sighs and turns his horse aside.

text.zh: 回营后诸葛亮要斩关羽，你跪在关羽身边。刘备求情，诸葛亮便收了令。关羽扶你起来的时候，手很重。
text.en: Back in camp Zhuge Liang orders Guan Yu executed, and you kneel beside him. Liu Bei pleads, and Zhuge Liang withdraws the order. When Guan Yu helps you up, his grip is heavy.

because.zh: 因为关羽送过你那卷《春秋》
because.en: Because Guan Yu once gave you his Annals

label.zh: 请求随关羽同去华容道监军。
label.en: Ask to go to Huarong with Guan Yu as overseer.

text.zh: 华容道上，曹操认出了你。
text.en: On the Huarong road, Cao Cao recognizes you.

text.zh: 『土山三约的执笔人也在。云长，我守了约。』
text.en: 'The man who wrote the three terms is here too. Yunchang, I kept my word.'

text.zh: 『青梅亭上的书生，你如今替谁说话？』
text.en: 'The scholar from the plum pavilion. Whose side are you speaking for now?'

text.zh: 关羽看了你一眼。你点了点头——或者你只是没有摇头。关羽拨开了马头。
text.en: Guan Yu looks at you. You nod—or perhaps you only fail to shake your head. Guan Yu turns his horse aside.

text.zh: 回营复命时，诸葛亮只问了一句：『你点头了？』你没有回答。他也没再问。
text.en: When you report back, Zhuge Liang asks only, 'Did you nod?' You don't answer. He doesn't ask again.

hint.zh: 需要诸葛亮的敬重在「器重」以上
hint.en: Needs Zhuge Liang's respect at Valued or above

label.zh: 托一个渔夫给曹营的温芷送一句话：走华容道，别走大路。
label.en: Pay a fisherman to take Wen Zhi a message in Cao's camp: take the Huarong road, not the main road.

text.zh: 你不知道话有没有送到。很久以后你才听说：曹军残部走华容道时，后队有个背药箱的女子，一路给伤兵包扎。
text.en: You never learn whether the message arrived. Much later you hear that when Cao's remnants came through Huarong, a woman with a medicine chest at the rear of the column bandaged the wounded all the way.

hint.zh: 需要与温芷足够亲近，且她仍在曹营
hint.en: Needs closeness with Wen Zhi, and for her to still be in Cao's camp

label.en: Say nothing.

text.zh: 关羽在华容道放走了曹操。回营后诸葛亮要斩他，刘备求情才免了。一切都和后来说书人讲的一样。
text.en: Guan Yu lets Cao go on the Huarong road. Back in camp Zhuge Liang orders his execution, and only Liu Bei's pleading spares him. Everything happens just as the storytellers will tell it.

quote.zh: 孔明曰：「亮夜观乾象，操贼未合身亡。留这人情，教云长做了，亦是美事。」
quote.en: Zhuge Liang said: "I have watched the heavens at night. Cao is not fated to die yet. Let Guan Yu repay his debt—that too is a fine thing."

text.zh: 关羽出帐前对你说：『土山那三条是你写的。曹公守了约。』他没有说下去。
text.en: On his way out, Guan Yu says to you, 'You wrote those three terms on the hill. Lord Cao kept them.' He leaves it there.

text.zh: 关羽说：『你问过我什么是义。这一回，我也不知道答案。』
text.en: Guan Yu says, 'You once asked me what righteousness is. This time I don't know the answer either.'

text.zh: 诸葛亮布置完，特意看了你一眼，像是在等你开口，又像是在防你开口。
text.en: When his orders are done, Zhuge Liang gives you a deliberate look—as if waiting for you to speak, or guarding against it.

text.zh: 刘备看着你：『长坂上你劝我弃民。今天你又要劝我什么？』
text.en: Liu Bei looks at you. 'At Changban you told me to abandon the people. What will you tell me today?'

text.zh: 温芷在帐后给伤兵换药，抬头看了你一眼。
text.en: Behind the tent, Wen Zhi is changing a wounded man's dressing. She looks up at you.

text.zh: 你摸了摸袖子里那包止血散。
text.en: You touch the packet of wound powder in your sleeve.

text.zh: 诸葛亮看了你一眼。自从那晚你说出三分天下，他一直是这样看你的。
text.en: Zhuge Liang glances at you. He has looked at you this way ever since the night you spoke of the three-way division.

means.zh: 劝关羽见到曹操就杀，别念旧恩
means.en: urges Guan Yu to kill Cao Cao on sight and forget old kindness

text.zh: 关羽丹凤眼一睁：『关某立了军令状，用不着你来提醒。』诸葛亮在一旁摇着扇子，像是什么都没听见。
text.en: Guan Yu's eyes snap open. 'I have signed the pledge. I don't need you to remind me.' Beside him Zhuge Liang fans himself as though he heard nothing.

moves.match: 杀了?曹(操|贼)|斩(了)?曹|别放(过)?曹|不要放|kill cao|don't (let|spare)

text.zh: 曹操带着残兵往华容道逃，人马都饿得站不住。转过山口，一彪人马拦住去路，为首的是关羽。
text.en: Cao Cao flees by the Huarong road with what's left of his army, men and horses half-starved. Around a bend a troop blocks the way, and at its head is Guan Yu.

text.zh: 关羽的目光越过曹操，落在你身上，停了很久。
text.en: Guan Yu's gaze passes over Cao Cao and rests on you for a long time.

label.zh: 你上前，求关羽念旧日情分。
label.en: Step forward and ask Guan Yu to remember old friendships.

text.zh: 『土山三约，是我写，丞相守。』你说，『将军也守一个吧。』
text.en: 'I wrote the three terms on that hill, and the Chancellor kept them,' you say. 'Keep one for us, General.'

text.zh: 关羽沉默良久，拨开马头，挥手让部下散开。曹操走过去的时候，关羽没有看他，看的是你。
text.en: Guan Yu is silent a long time, then turns his horse aside and waves his men apart. As Cao passes, Guan Yu doesn't look at him. He looks at you.

hint.zh: 需要关羽的敬重在「器重」以上
hint.en: Needs Guan Yu's respect at Valued or above

label.zh: 捧出关羽当年送你的那卷《春秋》。
label.en: Hold up the Annals Guan Yu gave you long ago.

text.zh: 关羽看见那卷书，手里的刀慢慢垂了下来。他拨开马头：『书，你留着吧。』曹操走过去的时候，关羽看的是你。
text.en: Guan Yu sees the scroll, and the blade in his hand slowly lowers. He turns his horse aside. 'Keep the book.' As Cao passes, Guan Yu is looking at you.

because.zh: 因为关羽送过你那卷《春秋》
because.en: Because Guan Yu once gave you his Annals

label.zh: 劝曹操亲自去说，提起当年的恩情。
label.en: Urge Cao to speak to him himself and recall old kindnesses.

text.zh: 曹操上前，说起当年五关斩将、他没有追究的事。关羽长叹一声，放他们过去了。
text.en: Cao rides forward and reminds Guan Yu how he never punished him for the generals killed at the five passes. Guan Yu sighs heavily and lets them through.

label.zh: 劝曹操亲自去说，提起当年的恩情。
label.en: Urge Cao to speak to him himself and recall old kindnesses.

text.zh: 曹操上前，说起当年五关斩将、他没有追究的事。关羽长叹一声，放他们过去了。
text.en: Cao rides forward and reminds Guan Yu how he never punished him for the generals killed at the five passes. Guan Yu sighs heavily and lets them through.

text.zh: 关羽让开路的时候，朝你点了一下头。
text.en: As Guan Yu clears the way, he gives you a single nod.

label.en: Draw your sword and stand in front of Cao.

text.zh: 你的剑在发抖。关羽看着你，像看一个孩子：『收起来吧。』他还是放了你们。
text.en: Your sword is shaking. Guan Yu looks at you as if at a child. 'Put it away.' He lets you all through anyway.

quote.zh: 操……欠身谓云长曰：「将军别来无恙？」云长亦欠身答曰：「关某奉军师将令，等候丞相多时。」
quote.en: Cao bowed slightly to Guan Yu: "General, have you been well since we parted?" Guan Yu bowed in return. "By the strategist's orders, I have been waiting for you a long time, Chancellor."

text.zh: 下游那二十条船救出了三千多人。曹操回头看了你一眼：『子衡那天说的，是真的。』
text.en: The twenty ships downstream saved over three thousand men. Cao glances back at you. 'What you said that day was true.'

text.zh: 温芷就在后队，药箱一件没丢。
text.en: Wen Zhi is at the rear of the column, not a single medicine chest lost.

text.zh: 关羽看见你，眼神动了一下：『长坂上那个缺口，是你开的？』
text.en: Guan Yu sees you and something moves in his face. 'That gap at Changban—was that you?'

text.zh: 关羽看见你：『你也在。』
text.en: Guan Yu sees you. 'You're here too.'

text.zh: 关羽看着你，说的还是那四个字：『人各有志。』
text.en: Guan Yu looks at you and says the same words as before: 'Every man chooses his own road.'

text.zh: 你回头看了一眼后队。温芷还在。
text.en: You glance back at the rear of the column. Wen Zhi is still there.

text.zh: 曹操低声说：『我留不住的人，又来了。』
text.en: Cao murmurs, 'The one I couldn't keep—here he is again.'

text.zh: 关羽看见你手腕上的勒痕，没问是怎么来的，只往火边让了让。
text.en: Guan Yu sees the rope marks on your wrists. He doesn't ask; he just makes room for you by the fire.

text.zh: 出许都的第一夜，大军扎营。关羽一个人坐在火边擦刀，见你过来，往旁边让了让。
text.en: The first night out of Xuchang, the army makes camp. Guan Yu sits alone by a fire, cleaning his blade. When he sees you he moves over to make room.

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 关羽冲你点了点头。火还旺着。
text.en: Guan Yu nods to you. The fire is still burning high.

label.en: Ask him about the oath in the peach garden.

text.zh: 『那年春天，三个人，一头黑牛，一匹白马。』他难得笑了，『大哥说，不求同年同月同日生。』
text.en: 'One spring. Three men, a black ox, a white horse.' He almost smiles. 'My brother said: we don't ask to be born on the same day.'

label.zh: 说说你自己：颍川、读书，为什么投刘备。
label.en: Tell him about yourself: Yingchuan, your studies, why you joined Liu Bei.

text.zh: 他听完，点点头：『为一个“仁”字投大哥的，你不是第一个。能留下来的，不多。』
text.en: He listens, then nods. 'You're not the first to follow my brother for his kindness. Not many stay.'

label.zh: 问他：将军也有怕的事吗？
label.en: Ask him: is there anything you're afraid of?

text.zh: 火噼啪响了一声。『怕负了大哥。』他把刀收进鞘里，『别的，不怕。』
text.en: The fire cracks. 'Failing my brother.' He sheathes the blade. 'Nothing else.'

hint.zh: 需要关羽的敬重在「寻常」以上
hint.en: Needs Guan Yu's respect at Ordinary or above

label.zh: 低声说：将来有一天，曹操会待你极厚，到时要记得今晚。
label.en: Say quietly: one day Cao Cao will treat you very well. Remember tonight when he does.

text.zh: 关羽皱眉看了你很久：『你这话，像是看见了什么。』他没有再问。
text.en: Guan Yu frowns at you for a long time. 'You talk as if you've seen something.' He doesn't ask further.

text.zh: 古城重聚的那一夜，刘备把你叫到城楼上。三兄弟终于又在一起了，他却没有喝醉。
text.en: The night the brothers reunite at Gucheng, Liu Bei calls you up onto the wall. The three of them are together at last, yet he hasn't let himself get drunk.

text.zh: 刘备没有提梅园那天你说的话。可他给你倒酒的时候，手停了一下。
text.en: Liu Bei doesn't mention what you said in the plum garden. But as he pours your wine, his hand pauses.

text.zh: 刘备笑着说：『梅园那天，你差点把我的命说没了。』他说完，自己先笑了。
text.en: Liu Bei says with a smile, 'That day in the plum garden, you nearly talked me out of my life.' He laughs first.

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 刘备在城楼上又站了很久。你先下去了。
text.en: Liu Bei stays on the wall a long time. You go down first.

label.zh: 问他：这些年一直寄人篱下，不觉得屈吗？
label.en: Ask him: all these years under other men's roofs—doesn't it gall you?

text.zh: 『屈。』他望着城下的火把，『可人在，事就还能做。』
text.en: 'It galls me.' He looks down at the torches below. 'But while we're alive, there's still work to do.'

label.zh: 问他：为什么百姓都愿意跟着你走？
label.en: Ask him: why are the common people so willing to follow you?

text.zh: 『我也不知道。』他想了想，『大概是我从没扔下过他们。』
text.en: 'I don't know.' He thinks. 'Perhaps because I've never left them behind.'

label.zh: 告诉他：往南走，荆州有人在等你。
label.en: Tell him: go south. Someone in Jingzhou is waiting for you.

text.zh: 刘备回过头：『谁？』你说不出名字。他拍拍你的肩：『那就等他来找我。』
text.en: Liu Bei turns. 'Who?' You can't give a name. He pats your shoulder. 'Then let him come and find me.'

text.zh: 诸葛亮出山后的第一个晚上，他提着一盏灯来敲你的门：『听说主公身边，子衡兄跟得最久。』
text.en: On his first night in Liu Bei's service, Zhuge Liang knocks on your door with a lamp. 'I hear you've been with our lord longest, Ziheng.'

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 灯芯爆了一下。诸葛亮起身告辞。
text.en: The lamp wick sputters. Zhuge Liang rises to take his leave.

label.en: Ask him: why did you agree to come?

text.zh: 『三顾，不是三请。』他笑，『一个人肯在雪里站三回，值得赌一赌。』
text.en: 'Three visits, not three invitations.' He smiles. 'A man who will stand in the snow three times is worth a wager.'

label.zh: 试探他：天下将三分，荆、益可图，对吗？
label.en: Test him: the realm will split in three, and Jing and Yi provinces are there for the taking—right?

text.zh: 诸葛亮手里的扇子停了。『这话，我只在草庐里说过。』他看了你很久，『子衡兄，你从哪里听来的？』
text.en: The fan in Zhuge Liang's hand stops. 'I've said that only in my cottage.' He studies you a long time. 'Where did you hear it, Ziheng?'

label.zh: 把你看到的主公说给他听：仁厚，信人，唯独对自己太苛。
label.en: Tell him the lord you know: kind, trusting of others, too hard on himself.

text.zh: 他认真记下：『多谢。往后，我们是同僚了。』
text.en: He takes it to heart. 'Thank you. From now on, we are colleagues.'

hint.zh: 需要诸葛亮的敬重在「寻常」以上
hint.en: Needs Zhuge Liang's respect at Ordinary or above

label.zh: 直说：你来之前，我是他最信的人。
label.en: Say it plainly: before you came, I was the one he trusted most.

text.zh: 『现在也是。』诸葛亮把灯留给了你，『我只是来帮他打仗的。』
text.en: 'You still are.' Zhuge Liang leaves the lamp with you. 'I'm only here to help him fight.'

text.zh: 宴罢，曹操留你在廊下说话。他喝了酒，话比平时多。
text.en: After the feast, Cao Cao keeps you on the veranda to talk. He has been drinking and says more than usual.

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 曹操挥挥手，让你回去歇着。
text.en: Cao waves you off to rest.

label.zh: 问他：丞相当年为何留我？
label.en: Ask him: why did you keep me, back then?

text.zh: 『因为你走得了，却没走。』曹操笑，『这样的人，用起来放心，也不放心。』
text.en: 'Because you could have left, and didn't.' Cao laughs. 'A man like that is easy to trust—and hard to.'

label.en: Ask him: do you still think about Guan Yunchang?

text.zh: 『想。』他倒了一杯酒，『我留不住的人，记得最清楚。』
text.en: 'I do.' He pours a cup. 'The ones I couldn't keep are the ones I remember best.'

label.en: Ask him to recite a new poem.

text.zh: 他低声吟了两句：『对酒当歌，人生几何。』又摆摆手，『还没写完。』
text.en: He murmurs two lines: 'Facing wine, I sing: how long is a life?' Then waves it off. 'It isn't finished.'

label.zh: 劝他：将来南征，切莫轻视东南风。
label.en: Warn him: when you march south, don't dismiss a southeast wind.

text.zh: 曹操眯起眼睛：『你也学那些术士？』他不再说话。
text.en: Cao narrows his eyes. 'Now you're imitating the soothsayers?' He says no more.

text.zh: 仗打完了。夜里，温芷在江边洗药杵。你走过去，她没有回头：『我就知道是你，脚步声都一样。』
text.en: The fighting is over. At night Wen Zhi is washing a pestle at the river's edge. You walk over; she doesn't turn around. 'I knew it was you. Your footsteps haven't changed.'

text.zh: 『你今天嘴怎么这么甜？』她头也不回地说，『有事求我？』
text.en: 'Why so sweet today?' she says without turning around. 'Want something from me?'

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 她把药杵擦干，收进药箱。『回去吧，江边冷。』
text.en: She dries the pestle and puts it away. 'Go back. It's cold by the river.'

label.en: Look at the burns on her hands.

text.zh: 她把手缩回袖子里：『医者的手，烧一回才知道疼。』过了一会儿，又伸出来给你看。
text.en: She pulls her hands into her sleeves. 'A physician should get burned once, to learn what it feels like.' After a while she holds them out for you to see.

label.zh: 说起颍川：等打完仗，回去看那棵槐树。
label.en: Talk about home: when the war's over, go back and see the old locust tree.

text.zh: 『许都没有槐树，南边也没有。』她笑了，『那就种一棵。』
text.en: 'There are no locust trees in Xuchang, or in the south.' She smiles. 'Then we'll plant one.'

label.en: Ask her: what do you want to do, afterwards?

text.zh: 『开一间药铺。不问来的人是哪一边的。』
text.en: 'Open an apothecary. And never ask which side the patients are on.'

label.zh: 把一直没说出口的话说出来。
label.en: Say what you've never said.

text.zh: 她终于回过头。江上还漂着烧黑的木头。『说了，就收不回去了。』『不收。』
text.en: She finally turns. Charred timbers still drift on the river. 'Once you say it, you can't take it back.' 'I won't.'

hint.zh: 需要与温芷的亲近在「心动」以上
hint.en: Needs closeness with Wen Zhi at Drawn or above

q.zh: 温芷把药箱放在脚边，看着江面：『这一仗打完，你想去哪？』
q.en: Wen Zhi sets her medicine chest at her feet and looks out at the water. 'When this battle's over, where do you want to go?'

means.zh: 敷衍、玩笑过头或冒犯她
means.en: brushes her off or insults her

text.zh: 温芷把药箱提了起来：『算了，当我没问。』
text.en: Wen Zhi picks up her medicine chest. 'Forget it. I didn't ask.'

answers.match: 关你|管得着|少管|啰嗦|none of your|mind your

means.zh: 回家乡、归隐、过平常日子、开药铺
means.en: home, a quiet life

text.zh: 温芷想了想：『开个药铺也好。晒药的竹匾，你来翻。』她说得像玩笑，又不太像。
text.en: Wen Zhi thinks about it. 'An apothecary would do. You can turn the drying trays.' She says it like a joke, and not quite.

means.zh: 想和她在一起、去她在的地方
means.en: wherever she is

text.zh: 她没有回头，耳朵却红了：『……这算是回答吗？』
text.en: She doesn't turn around, but her ears go red. '…Is that an answer?'

text.zh: 她愣了一下，笑着摇头：『你连我想去哪都不知道。』
text.en: She blinks, then laughs and shakes her head. 'You don't even know where I want to go.'

means.zh: 继续辅佐主公、去下一个战场
means.en: back to his lord, the next campaign

text.zh: 她点点头：『我就知道。』过了一会儿又说：『那你记得带上金疮药。』
text.en: She nods. 'I knew it.' After a while she adds, 'Then remember to take wound salve.'

means.en: doesn't know

text.zh: 『我也不知道。』她说，『那就先活着打完。』
text.en: 'Neither do I,' she says. 'Then let's get through it alive first.'

text.zh: 回营那夜，关羽独自坐在帐外，刀横在膝上。
text.en: The night you return to camp, Guan Yu sits alone outside his tent, the blade across his knees.

text.zh: 关羽看了你一眼：『今夜不必说好听的。』
text.en: Guan Yu glances at you. 'No sweet words tonight.'

text.zh: 关羽看着火，忽然说：『许都那天，劝曹操拦我的，是你。』
text.en: Guan Yu watches the fire and suddenly says, 'That day in Xuchang, the one who urged Cao Cao to stop me—that was you.'

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 你回帐时，他还坐在那里。
text.en: When you go back to your tent, he is still sitting there.

label.en: Ask him: do you regret letting Cao go?

text.zh: 『不悔。』他看着刀，『可我欠大哥一条命。』
text.en: 'No.' He looks at the blade. 'But I owe my brother a life.'

label.zh: 提起那晚的篝火：你说过最怕负了大哥。
label.en: Remind him of the campfire: you said you feared failing your brother.

text.zh: 关羽沉默了很久：『今天，我负了吗？』你说没有。他点点头，像是信了。
text.en: Guan Yu is silent a long time. 'Did I fail him today?' You say no. He nods, as if he believes you.

label.zh: 什么也不说，陪他坐一会儿。
label.en: Say nothing. Just sit with him for a while.

text.zh: 风从江上吹过来。天快亮的时候，他说：『多谢。』
text.en: The wind comes off the river. Near dawn he says, 'Thank you.'

text.zh: 北归路上，曹操想起郭嘉，放声大哭：『若奉孝在，决不使吾有此大失也！』哭完了，他让你并马而行。
text.en: On the road north, Cao Cao remembers Guo Jia and weeps aloud: 'Had Fengxiao lived, I would never have suffered such a loss!' When he is done, he has you ride beside him.

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 前面就是南郡了。
text.en: Nanjun lies ahead.

label.en: Tell him: victory and defeat are a soldier's daily bread.

text.zh: 『常事？』他冷笑，『八十万人，是常事？』可他的背挺直了些。
text.en: 'Daily bread?' He laughs coldly. 'Eight hundred thousand men?' But he sits a little straighter.

label.en: Say it straight: this battle was lost to pride.

text.zh: 曹操盯着你：『你敢说，我就敢听。』他没有再哭。
text.en: Cao stares at you. 'If you dare say it, I dare hear it.' He doesn't weep again.

hint.zh: 需要曹操的赏识在「器重」以上
hint.en: Needs Cao's regard at Valued or above

label.en: Hand him your water flask without a word.

text.zh: 他喝了一口，没有说话。
text.en: He drinks and says nothing.

text.zh: 军中开始传：刘备帐下有个书生能未卜先知，是妖人。张飞拍着桌子要把你绑来问个清楚。刘备把你叫进内帐，诸葛亮也在。
text.en: Word spreads through the camp: a scholar in Liu Bei's household can see the future—a sorcerer. Zhang Fei pounds the table and wants you tied up and questioned. Liu Bei calls you into his tent.

text.zh: 诸葛亮也在帐中。
text.en: Zhuge Liang is there too.

text.zh: 许都开始传：丞相府有个能知未来的人。曹操最恨术士。他把你叫去，程昱也在。
text.en: Word spreads through Xuchang: someone in the Chancellor's office can see the future. Cao Cao hates soothsayers. He summons you; Cheng Yu is there too.

label.zh: 说实话：你梦见过这一切。
label.en: Tell the truth: you have dreamed all of this.

text.zh: 刘备沉默良久，亲自送你出营：『先生的梦，我不敢留。』
text.en: Liu Bei is silent a long time, then walks you out of the camp himself. 'I dare not keep a man with dreams like yours.'

text.zh: 曹操大笑。笑完了，他下令把你送出许都，永不许回。
text.en: Cao Cao roars with laughter. When he's done, he has you escorted out of Xuchang, never to return.

label.zh: 说是推算：天时、地利、人事，算得出来。
label.en: Say it's calculation: weather, terrain and people—it can be reckoned.

text.zh: 诸葛亮替你圆了这个说法：『子衡兄的算法，亮也会。』流言慢慢散了。他私下对你说：『下次，先告诉我。』
text.en: Zhuge Liang backs your story. 'I can reckon the same way.' The rumors die down. In private he tells you, 'Next time, tell me first.'

hint.zh: 需要诸葛亮的敬重在「器重」以上，他才会替你说话
hint.en: Needs Zhuge Liang's respect at Valued or above for him to speak for you

label.zh: 请丞相当场出一道题，推算给他看。
label.en: Ask the Chancellor to set you a problem on the spot, and reckon it for him.

text.zh: 你算对了。曹操没有再追问，只是从此每次议事都让你坐得离他近一些——好看着你。
text.en: You get it right. Cao asks no more—but from then on, at every council, he seats you closer to him. The better to watch you.

hint.zh: 需要曹操的赏识在「推崇」以上
hint.en: Needs Cao's regard at Admired or above

label.zh: 矢口否认，从此闭口不言。
label.en: Deny everything, and keep your mouth shut from now on.

text.zh: 流言没有散，只是换了说法：那书生怕了。主公看你的眼神，多了一层东西。
text.en: The rumors don't go away; they just change: the scholar got scared. Your lord looks at you differently now.

text.zh: 你发现，议事的时候已经没有人等你开口了。刘备待你仍旧客气，只是不再问你。
text.en: You notice that at council no one waits for you to speak any more. Liu Bei is as courteous as ever. He just doesn't ask you anything.

label.en: Resign.

text.zh: 刘备没有挽留，送了你一匹马和一包盘缠：『子衡保重。』
text.en: Liu Bei doesn't try to stop you. He gives you a horse and travel money. 'Take care, Ziheng.'

label.zh: 留下来，做个抄写文书的小吏。
label.en: Stay on as a copying clerk.

text.zh: 你的案头堆满了别人的文书。日子还长。
text.en: Your desk fills with other men's paperwork. There's a long road ahead.

label.zh: 请命去做一件没人愿意做的事。
label.en: Volunteer for the job nobody wants.

text.zh: 你在泥地里走了三个月，替刘备把各郡的粮册重新理了一遍。回来那天，他亲自出城接你。
text.en: You spend three months tramping through mud, putting the grain registers of every district in order. The day you return, Liu Bei rides out of the city to meet you himself.

hint.zh: 需要一点忠义之名，主公才肯给你机会
hint.en: Needs some name for loyalty before he'll give you the chance

text.zh: 丞相府的人都知道：子衡失宠了。你的文书被退回来三次，每次都没有批语。
text.en: Everyone in the Chancellor's office knows: Ziheng has lost favor. Your memoranda come back three times, each without a word written on them.

label.en: Ask to be posted to the provinces.

text.zh: 曹操批了，一个字：『可。』你去了一个在地图上要找很久的小县。
text.en: Cao approves it with one word: 'Granted.' You go to a county so small it takes a while to find on the map.

label.en: Stay in the quiet post, and wait.

text.zh: 你学会了在廊下晒太阳。也学会了听别人议事时不插嘴。
text.en: You learn to sit in the sun on the veranda, and to listen at councils without speaking.

label.zh: 连夜写一份平定荆州的方略，放到他案头。
label.en: Write a plan for taking Jingzhou overnight and leave it on his desk.

text.zh: 第二天一早，曹操派人来叫你。方略上全是朱笔批注。
text.en: Early next morning Cao sends for you. Your plan is covered in his red-ink notes.

hint.zh: 需要权谋之名 ≥ 2
hint.en: Needs name for cunning ≥ 2

text.zh: 夜里关羽来找你，手里是一卷翻得起了毛边的《春秋》，页边都是他的批注：『这一卷，我读了二十年。你拿着。』
text.en: Guan Yu comes to you at night with a copy of the Spring and Autumn Annals, its edges worn soft, its margins full of his notes. 'I've read this for twenty years. You keep it.'

label.en: Accept it, and bow your thanks.

text.zh: 关羽点点头，转身走了。那卷书很沉。
text.en: Guan Yu nods and leaves. The scroll is heavy.

label.zh: 推辞：『将军的书，我不敢收。』
label.en: Decline: 'I couldn't take your book, General.'

text.zh: 关羽把书放在你案上：『那就算借你。总有一天，你还给我。』
text.en: Guan Yu sets it on your desk. 'Then it's a loan. One day you'll give it back.'

text.zh: 温芷托人捎来一个药囊，针脚密密的，里面是止血的药粉，还有一张字条：『别让我在伤兵堆里找到你。』
text.en: Wen Zhi sends you a medicine pouch, closely stitched, full of powder to stop bleeding, with a note: 'Don't make me find you among the wounded.'

label.en: Keep it close, inside your robe.

text.zh: 你把药囊系在了腰带里侧。
text.en: You tie the pouch to the inside of your belt.

label.en: Send a note back: 'You too.'

text.zh: 过了几天，字条又回来了，只多了两个字：『知道。』
text.en: A few days later the note comes back with one word added: 'Understood.'

text.zh: 程昱来串门，坐了一盏茶的工夫，临走才说：『丞相让我多照看照看你。』从那天起，你出门，总觉得身后有人。
text.en: Cheng Yu drops by and sits through a cup of tea. Only as he leaves does he say, 'The Chancellor asked me to look after you.' From that day on, whenever you go out, you feel someone behind you.

label.en: Pretend not to notice.

text.zh: 身后的人一直在。你学会了走路时不回头。
text.en: The man behind you stays. You learn not to look back when you walk.

label.zh: 去见曹操，把话说开：『丞相若信不过我，我走。』
label.en: Go to Cao Cao and have it out: 'If you don't trust me, Chancellor, I'll go.'

text.zh: 曹操大笑：『孤若信不过你，你早不在许都了。』第二天，身后的人不见了。
text.en: Cao Cao roars with laughter. 'If I didn't trust you, you'd have left Xuchang long ago.' The next day the man behind you is gone.

hint.zh: 需要曹操对你的赏识至少是「寻常」
hint.en: Needs Cao's regard at Ordinary or above

text.zh: 你在宴后当面顶撞了曹操。第二天，丞相府传出话来：要派你出使荆州，去见刘表。府里的人都知道，几个月前，一个叫祢衡的狂士，也是这样被送走的。
text.en: You defied Cao Cao to his face after the feast. The next day word comes from his office: you are to go as envoy to Liu Biao in Jingzhou. Everyone in the household knows that months ago a brash scholar named Mi Heng was sent away exactly like this.

label.en: Accept the mission.

text.zh: 你带着一纸国书南下。刘表待你客气，又把你转送江夏。你终于明白了曹操的意思：他不必亲手杀你。
text.en: You go south with a letter of state. Liu Biao receives you politely, then sends you on to Jiangxia. At last you understand Cao's meaning: he doesn't need to kill you himself.

label.en: Kneel at the Chancellor's gate and beg forgiveness.

text.zh: 你跪了一整天。傍晚，曹操让人传话：『起来吧。孤要的是会说话的人，不是不会说话的人。』
text.en: You kneel all day. At dusk Cao sends word: 'Get up. I want men who know how to speak—not men who don't know when to stop.'

hint.zh: 需要曹操的赏识在「推崇」以上，他才肯给你台阶
hint.en: Needs Cao's regard at Admired or above for him to give you a way back

label.zh: 当着来使的面，再骂一次。
label.en: Curse him again, in front of his messenger.

text.zh: 来使面色惨白地回去复命。曹操只笑了一声：『送他去荆州。』你学祢衡学到了底。
text.en: The messenger goes back ashen-faced. Cao only laughs once. 'Send him to Jingzhou.' You have followed Mi Heng all the way.

text.zh: 有人把你夜里说的那些话，一句一句报给了刘备。张飞拍着桌子：『这种人留在身边做什么？』
text.en: Someone has reported to Liu Bei, word for word, the things you've been saying at night. Zhang Fei pounds the table. 'Why keep a man like that around?'

text.zh: 程昱把一张纸放在曹操案头，上面抄着你这些日子说过的话。曹操看完，叫你过去。
text.en: Cheng Yu lays a sheet on Cao Cao's desk: a copy of everything you've said lately. Cao reads it and sends for you.

label.zh: 认错：话说过了头，愿受责罚。
label.en: Admit it: you spoke out of turn, and will accept the consequences.

text.zh: 主公没有罚你，只说：『先生是聪明人，聪明人最该管住嘴。』
text.en: Your lord doesn't punish you. He only says, 'You're a clever man. Clever men most of all should mind their tongues.'

label.zh: 辩解：都是真心话，句句有所指。
label.en: Defend yourself: you meant every word, and each had a point.

text.zh: 你一句一句解释。主公听完，沉默了很久：『有些真话，要挑时候说。』这件事就这样过去了。
text.en: You explain each line. Your lord listens and is silent for a long time. 'Some truths need the right moment.' And there it ends.

hint.zh: 需要主公足够信你：刘备的信任在「倚重」以上，或曹操的赏识在「推崇」以上
hint.en: Needs your lord's confidence: Liu Bei's trust at Relied on or above, or Cao's regard at Admired or above

label.en: Resign.

text.zh: 没有人挽留你。你走的那天，连送行的人都没有。
text.en: No one asks you to stay. On the day you leave, no one even sees you off.

text.zh: 曹操把酒樽往案上一顿。笑意还挂在脸上，眼睛已经冷了：『玄德，你这位门客，是替你来试孤的？』廊下的甲士按着刀，往前走了一步。刘备离席，伏在地上不起来。
text.en: Cao Cao sets his cup down hard. The smile is still on his face; his eyes have gone cold. 'Xuande—did you bring this guest of yours to test me?' The guards under the eaves step forward, hands on their swords. Liu Bei leaves his seat and goes down on the ground, and stays there.

label.zh: 一个人担下来：『狂言是我一人的，与刘使君无关。』
label.en: Take it all on yourself: 'The wild talk was mine alone. Lord Liu had nothing to do with it.'

text.zh: 曹操盯着你看了很久：『好，有担当。拖下去，打二十棍，扔出府门。』棍子落下来的时候，你听见刘备在席上替你求情。那天夜里，他亲自来给你上药，一句责备的话也没说。
text.en: Cao studies you for a long time. 'Good. A man who answers for himself. Take him out, twenty strokes, and throw him into the street.' As the rod comes down you hear Liu Bei pleading for you inside. That night he comes himself to dress your back, and says not one word of reproach.

label.zh: 跟着主公一起伏地请罪。
label.en: Go down beside your lord and beg forgiveness.

text.zh: 刘备替你磕了三个头。曹操这才笑了：『醉话而已，玄德何必当真。』酒宴照旧。回去的路上，刘备说：『今天差一点，就是你我两条命。』
text.en: Liu Bei touches his head to the floor three times for you. Only then does Cao laugh. 'Drunken talk. Why take it so seriously, Xuande?' The feast goes on. On the way home Liu Bei says, 'Today it nearly cost us both our lives.'

label.zh: 举杯转圜：把刚才的狂话，说成是替丞相不平——天下英雄，没人配与丞相对饮。
label.en: Raise your cup and turn it: your wild words were outrage on the Chancellor's behalf—no one in the realm is fit to drink with him.

text.zh: 曹操盯着你，忽然大笑：『好一张嘴！』他亲自给你斟了一杯。酒宴照旧。只是从那天起，许都多了几双盯着刘备的眼睛。
text.en: Cao stares at you, then bursts out laughing. 'What a tongue!' He pours your cup himself. The feast goes on. But from that day, more eyes in Xuchang are watching Liu Bei.

hint.zh: 需要“权谋”名声 ≥ 1：你得是个出了名会说话的人，曹操才肯接这个台阶
hint.en: Needs a name for cunning ≥ 1: Cao only takes the way out from a man known for his tongue

label.en: Lift your chin and finish what you were saying.

text.zh: 曹操笑了：『好。孤成全你。』你被押进了许都大牢。刘备出城那天，你在牢里听见城外的马蹄声。
text.en: Cao smiles. 'Very well. You shall have what you want.' You are taken to the Xuchang jail. On the day Liu Bei rides out of the city, you hear the hooves from your cell.

label.en: imprisoned
Lift your chin and finish what you were saying.

text.zh: 曹操脸上的笑一点一点收了：『推出去。』廊下的甲士把你从席上拖起来。刘备扑过来，被许褚一把按住。雨落下来的时候，刀也落了下来。
text.en: The smile drains from Cao Cao's face. 'Take him out.' The guards haul you from your seat. Liu Bei lunges forward and Xu Chu pins him. As the rain comes down, so does the blade.

label.en: executed
Fall to the floor and beg for your life.

text.zh: 曹操低头看了你一眼：『同样的话，孤不听第二遍。』
text.en: Cao Cao glances down at you. 'I don't hear the same words twice.'

text.zh: 曹操脸上的笑一点一点收了：『推出去。』廊下的甲士把你从席上拖起来。刘备扑过来，被许褚一把按住。雨落下来的时候，刀也落了下来。
text.en: The smile drains from Cao Cao's face. 'Take him out.' The guards haul you from your seat. Liu Bei lunges forward and Xu Chu pins him. As the rain comes down, so does the blade.

label.en: executed

label.zh: 盯着曹操，把那句话再说一遍。
label.en: Look Cao Cao in the eye and say it again.

text.zh: 曹操脸上的笑一点一点收了：『推出去。』廊下的甲士把你从席上拖起来。刘备扑过来，被许褚一把按住。雨落下来的时候，刀也落了下来。
text.en: The smile drains from Cao Cao's face. 'Take him out.' The guards haul you from your seat. Liu Bei lunges forward and Xu Chu pins him. As the rain comes down, so does the blade.

label.en: executed

text.zh: 你在墙上刻到第九十道的时候，外面的消息已经传遍了：刘备请命截击袁术，带着五万兵马出了城。没有人来接你。
text.en: By the time you've scratched the ninetieth mark on the wall, the news is everywhere: Liu Bei volunteered to intercept Yuan Shu and rode out with fifty thousand men. No one came for you.

label.en: Wait.

text.zh: 又过了一个月，狱卒打开门：『丞相说，放了。』没人告诉你为什么。你一路向东，在徐州城外追上了刘备。他看见你，下了马，什么也没说，把自己的斗篷披在你身上。
text.en: Another month passes. Then the jailer opens the door. 'The Chancellor says let him go.' No one tells you why. You head east and catch up with Liu Bei outside Xuzhou. When he sees you, he dismounts, says nothing, and puts his own cloak around your shoulders.

label.en: Get word to Wen Zhi.

text.zh: 第七天，温芷提着药箱进了牢房，说是给犯人看病。她走后，你在药包底下摸到一张盖了印的路引。那天夜里，你出了许都。
text.en: On the seventh day Wen Zhi comes into the jail with her medicine chest, saying she's here to treat the prisoners. After she leaves, you find a stamped travel pass under the herbs. That night you are out of Xuchang.

hint.zh: 需要和温芷走得足够近（亲近在「在意」以上，或托过她打听消息）
hint.en: Needs to be close to Wen Zhi (closeness at Caring or above, or have asked her for news)

label.en: Write to Cao Cao and recant.

text.zh: 曹操看完你的信，笑了：『早这样不就好了。』当天就放了你。可这封信后来传到了刘备耳朵里。他没提，你知道他听说了。
text.en: Cao reads your letter and laughs. 'Why not do this sooner?' You're released that day. But word of the letter reaches Liu Bei. He never mentions it. You know he's heard.

text.zh: 曹操的脸色变了。『刘备的人，在孤面前也敢这样说话？』他抬了抬手，身后的人就把你按在了地上。
text.en: Cao's face changes. 'One of Liu Bei's men, talking like that in front of me?' He lifts a hand, and the men behind him pin you to the floor.

text.zh: 曹操把手里的竹简往案上一摔：『孤给你脸，你偏不要。』许褚已经走到了你身后。
text.en: Cao slams his bamboo slips onto the desk. 'I give you face, and you throw it back at me.' Xu Chu is already standing behind you.

label.en: Bow to the floor and beg his pardon.

text.zh: 曹操让你在地上跪了一个时辰，才挥了挥手：『滚。』
text.en: Cao leaves you kneeling for an hour before he waves a hand. 'Get out.'

label.zh: 用一句妙语把话圆回来。
label.en: Turn it with a well-placed line.

text.zh: 曹操愣了一下，大笑：『罢了！你这张嘴，迟早害死你。』
text.en: Cao is caught off guard, then roars with laughter. 'Enough! That tongue of yours will be the death of you.'

hint.zh: 需要曹操的赏识在「推崇」以上，他才肯听你圆
hint.en: Needs Cao's regard at Admired or above for him to let you talk your way out

label.en: Refuse to kneel.

text.zh: 许褚的手按上你的肩。关羽站了起来：『此人是我兄长的人。要罚，连关某一起罚。』曹操看了关羽很久，挥了挥手。
text.en: Xu Chu's hand closes on your shoulder. Guan Yu rises. 'This man belongs to my brother. Punish him, and you punish me too.' Cao looks at Guan Yu a long time, then waves his hand.

label.en: Refuse to kneel.

text.zh: 曹操没有再问第二遍，只抬了抬手。你被拖出门的时候，听见他在身后说：『可惜了。』
text.en: Cao Cao doesn't ask twice; he only lifts his hand. As you're dragged out you hear him behind you: 'A pity.'

label.en: executed
Refuse to kneel.

text.zh: 曹操说：『祢衡走过的路，你也走一遍吧。』第二天，你被送往荆州。
text.en: Cao says, 'Mi Heng's road—you may walk it too.' The next day you are sent to Jingzhou.

label.en: Refuse to kneel.
