label.en: executed

text.zh: 刘备慢慢放下手里的东西，看着你，很久没有说话。门外，张飞的影子停住了。刘备终于开口，声音很轻：『先生跟了备这些年。这句话，备想听你再说一遍——是醉话，还是真话？』
text.en: Liu Bei slowly sets down what he's holding and looks at you for a long time without a word. Outside the door, Zhang Fei's shadow stops. At last Liu Bei speaks, very quietly. 'You've followed me all these years, sir. I want to hear you say it once more—was that drink talking, or the truth?'

label.en: Kneel: it was drink talking—madness.

text.zh: 刘备扶你起来，拍了拍你的肩：『那就当没说过。』可从那天起，议事的时候，他不再先问你。
text.en: Liu Bei helps you up and pats your shoulder. 'Then it was never said.' But from that day on, in council, he no longer asks you first.

label.zh: 说：是真话——可我想杀的不是你，是那个寄人篱下、什么都不敢做的你。
label.en: Say: it was the truth—but what I want to kill isn't you, it's the you who lives under other men's roofs and dares nothing.

text.zh: 刘备愣住了。半晌，他笑了，眼眶却是红的：『先生这一刀，备受了。』
text.en: Liu Bei is stunned. After a long moment he laughs, though his eyes are red. 'I'll take that cut, sir.'

label.en: Say: it was the truth.

text.zh: 刘备点点头，没有叫张飞进来。他让人给你备了一匹马、一袋盘缠：『先生另择明主吧。备不送了。』那天夜里，你出了城。
text.en: Liu Bei nods and does not call Zhang Fei in. He has a horse and a purse of travel money made ready for you. 'Choose a better lord, sir. I won't see you off.' That night you leave the city.

label.en: sent away

text.zh: 关羽的丹凤眼睁开了。他没有拍案，只是把青龙刀从架上取了下来，刀尖点地：『你再说一遍。』
text.en: Guan Yu's long eyes open. He doesn't slam the table; he simply lifts the Green Dragon blade from its rack and sets its point to the floor. 'Say that again.'

label.zh: 收回这句话，向关羽赔罪。
label.en: Take it back and apologize to Guan Yu.

text.zh: 关羽看了你很久，把刀放回了架上：『下不为例。』
text.en: Guan Yu looks at you a long while, then sets the blade back on its rack. 'Never again.'

label.en: Don't back down; put your hand on your sword hilt.

text.zh: 关羽的刀背砸在你肩上，你整个人撞翻了案几。张飞冲进来把你拖了出去，一路骂着。那天夜里，刘备来给你上药，一句话也没说。
text.en: The back of Guan Yu's blade slams into your shoulder and sends you crashing over the table. Zhang Fei storms in and drags you out, cursing all the way. That night Liu Bei comes to dress your wound and says nothing at all.

label.en: wounded
Draw your sword.

text.zh: 你的剑还没出鞘，就被张飞一把夺了过去。第二天一早，刘备让人牵来一匹马：『先生走吧。我兄弟的刀，我拦得住一次。』
text.en: Before your sword clears the scabbard Zhang Fei has wrenched it away. At dawn Liu Bei has a horse brought round. 'Go, sir. I can stop my brother's blade once.'

label.en: sent away

text.zh: 你没有走出许都。那年的梅子，后来是别人摘的。
text.en: You never left Xuchang. Someone else picked the plums that year.

text.zh: 你和祢衡一样，被送去了荆州。后来的事，没有人记得很清楚——史书里，只多了一句“又有狂士某”。
text.en: Like Mi Heng, you were sent to Jingzhou. What happened after, no one remembers clearly; the histories add only 'and another brash scholar.'

text.zh: 你的名字后来出现在好几本笔记里，都在“异人”那一卷。至于赤壁，你是在家乡听说的——和你梦见的一模一样。
text.en: Your name later turns up in several miscellanies, always in the chapter on strange men. As for Red Cliffs, you hear about it back home—exactly as you dreamed it.

text.zh: 你带着一匹马离开了。后来的事，你是从说书人嘴里听来的。
text.en: You left with a horse and little else. You heard the rest of the story from the storytellers.

text.zh: 你仍在刘备帐下，随他南取荆州。
text.en: You remain in Liu Bei's service and follow him south to take Jingzhou.

text.zh: 你随曹操北还许都，名字写进了丞相府的名册。
text.en: You return north to Xuchang with Cao Cao, your name entered in the Chancellor's rolls.

text.zh: 刘备说：『孔明是我的水，子衡是我的井。』这话传出去被人笑了很久，你却记了一辈子。
text.en: Liu Bei says, 'Kongming is my river; Ziheng is my well.' People laugh at that for years. You remember it all your life.

text.zh: 刘备敬重你，遇事会问你。但你知道，最后拿主意的人已经是诸葛亮了。
text.en: Liu Bei respects you and asks your opinion. But you know the man who decides is Zhuge Liang now.

text.zh: 刘备待你始终客气。客气，就是隔着一层。
text.en: Liu Bei is always courteous to you. Courtesy is a kind of distance.

text.zh: 曹操把你列为心腹谋臣，与程昱、荀攸同席。
text.en: Cao Cao counts you among his closest advisers, seated with Cheng Yu and Xun You.

text.zh: 曹操用你，也防你。他从没忘记你是从刘备那里来的。
text.en: Cao Cao uses you, and watches you. He never forgets you came from Liu Bei.

text.zh: 人说子衡口无遮拦。喜欢你的人说你真，怕你的人说你狂。
text.en: People say Ziheng can't hold his tongue. Those who like you call it honesty; those who fear you call it madness.

text.zh: 坊间传说你能知未来。敬你的人叫你『先生』，怕你的人叫你『妖人』。
text.en: People say you can see the future. Those who respect you call you 'Master'; those who fear you call you a sorcerer.

text.zh: 人说子衡有古人之风，重义。
text.en: People say Ziheng is a man of the old kind, who keeps faith.

text.zh: 人说子衡多智，也说子衡心深。
text.en: People say Ziheng is clever, and that his mind runs deep.

text.zh: 史书里没有你的传，只有几处『或曰』。
text.en: The histories give you no biography—just a few lines beginning 'some say.'

text.zh: 华容道之后，关羽每次喝酒都要先敬你一杯：『那一跪，我记着。』
text.en: After Huarong, whenever Guan Yu drinks, he raises the first cup to you. 'I remember that you knelt.'

text.zh: 华容道上关羽让开的那条路，曹操记在了你的名下。
text.en: Cao Cao credits you with the road Guan Yu opened at Huarong.

text.zh: 关羽一直记着欠你的那份情。他不常说，但每逢有人议论你，他就把刀往桌上一放。
text.en: Guan Yu never forgets what he owes you. He rarely mentions it, but whenever someone talks about you behind your back, he sets his blade on the table.

text.zh: 关羽敬你。在他那里，这比喜欢难得多。
text.en: Guan Yu respects you. With him, that is much harder to earn than liking.

text.zh: 关羽说起你，只有两个字：『可惜。』
text.en: When Guan Yu speaks of you, it's one word: 'Pity.'

text.zh: 你和关羽，始终是点头之交。
text.en: You and Guan Yu remain nodding acquaintances.

text.zh: 那一句『你点头了？』，诸葛亮到最后也没有再问。
text.en: Zhuge Liang never asks again whether you nodded.

text.zh: 诸葛亮对你始终存着一分戒心。你知道得太多，又说不出是从哪里知道的。
text.en: Zhuge Liang never quite lowers his guard with you. You know too much, and can't say how.

text.zh: 诸葛亮出兵前，会把方略先给你看一遍。
text.en: Before any campaign, Zhuge Liang shows you his plans first.

text.zh: 诸葛亮与你相处融洽，却没有深交。
text.en: You and Zhuge Liang get along, but never grow close.

text.zh: 那一夜江边说出口的话，你们谁都没有收回。后来你们在公安城外成了亲，开了一间药铺，不问来人是哪一边的。
text.en: Neither of you ever took back what was said by the river that night. Later you married outside Gong'an and opened an apothecary that never asked which side its patients were on.

text.zh: 温芷跟你回了南岸。她手上的疤一直没消。后来你们在公安城外开了一间药铺，晒药的竹匾你来翻。
text.en: Wen Zhi comes back to the south bank with you. The scars on her hands never fade. Later the two of you open an apothecary outside Gong'an, and you turn the drying trays.

text.zh: 你和温芷在许都成了家。你在丞相府起草文书，她在药圃里晒当归。
text.en: You and Wen Zhi make a home in Xuchang. You draft documents for the Chancellor; she dries angelica in the garden.

text.zh: 赤壁那一夜，后营的病兵一个没丢。温芷说，那天你叫她搬，是她这辈子听过最没道理、也最对的话。
text.en: On the night of the fire, not one patient in the rear camp was lost. Wen Zhi says that when you told her to move them, it was the least reasonable and most correct thing she ever heard.

text.zh: 温芷再没回过信。你后来才明白：她冒着性命写来的东西，被你当成了军报。
text.en: Wen Zhi never writes again. Only later do you understand: what she risked her life to write, you treated as military intelligence.

text.zh: 温芷随曹军北还。每年冬至，你都会收到一包止血散，没有信。
text.en: Wen Zhi goes north with Cao's army. Every year at the solstice a packet of wound powder arrives for you, with no letter.

text.zh: 你很久没有温芷的消息了。
text.en: You haven't heard from Wen Zhi in a long time.

text.zh: 你在许都的大牢里待过三个月。后来有人问起，你只说：那里很安静，适合想事情。
text.en: You spent three months in the Xuchang jail. When people ask about it later, you say only: it was quiet, good for thinking.

text.zh: 梅园那二十棍，在你背上留了疤。刘备每次看见，都不说话。
text.en: The twenty strokes from the plum garden left scars on your back. Whenever Liu Bei sees them, he says nothing.

text.zh: 徐庶没有北去。他的母亲被软禁在许都，母子再没见面，但都活着。
text.en: Xu Shu never went north. His mother lives under guard in Xuchang; they never meet again, but both are alive.

text.zh: 糜夫人没有投井。阿斗长大后，叫你『子衡叔』。
text.en: Lady Mi never threw herself into the well. When Adou grows up, he calls you Uncle Ziheng.

text.zh: 东岭关的孔秀活了下来。说书人讲『过五关斩六将』时，你总想纠正：是五将。
text.en: Kong Xiu of Dongling Pass survived. Whenever storytellers recite 'five passes, six generals,' you want to correct them: five.

text.zh: 庞统早来了好几年。很久以后，你会想起一个叫落凤坡的地名，然后决定什么都不说。
text.en: Pang Tong came years early. Long afterwards, a place called Fallen Phoenix Slope will cross your mind, and you will decide to say nothing.

text.zh: 长坂坡上那个缺口，你到死都没有告诉曹操。
text.en: You never tell Cao Cao about the gap at Changban, not to your dying day.

text.zh: 徐母的灵位，你每年都去上一炷香。
text.en: Every year you light incense before Xu Shu's mother's spirit tablet.

text.zh: 下游那二十条船上的三千人，后来有很多成了你的兵。
text.en: Many of the three thousand saved on those twenty ships later served under you.

text.zh: 说书人讲到这一段，总有几处讲不顺——那几处，都是你。
text.en: When storytellers reach this part, a few places never quite fit. Those places are you.

text.zh: 史书和演义大体如常，只在几个角落多了几行小字。
text.en: The histories and the novel run much as they always did, with a few lines of small print added in the corners.

text.zh: 后人读《三国》，找不到你的名字。你只是改变了一些人的一些日子。
text.en: Later readers of the Three Kingdoms will never find your name. You only changed some days in some lives.

garden.zh: 水墨淡彩，宽幅。许都后园，青梅枝从左上探入，远处城墙，右侧小亭中二人对坐煮酒，雷雨将至。图层：雷雨（闪电、雨丝）。
garden.en: Chinese ink wash with light color, wide banner. A walled garden in Xuchang: green-plum branches from the upper left, distant city wall, two men seated drinking in a small pavilion on the right, storm gathering. Layer: storm (lightning, rain).

lamp.zh: 夜，窗格内一灯如豆，一人跪坐读书，窗外竹影。图层：案上一道红色血诏。
lamp.en: Night. Through a lattice window a single lamp, a seated man reading, bamboo shadows outside. Layer: a red silk edict on the desk.

herbs.zh: 药圃，圆形月洞门，竹匾晒药，一名医女。图层：同行男子；春日落花；粉色花瓣（恋爱时刻）。
herbs.en: Herb garden with a round moon gate, bamboo drying trays, a woman physician. Layers: a man beside her; spring blossoms; pink petals (romance moment).

road.zh: 平原大路，行军队列与红旗，远处许都城墙。图层：远处尘土中的追骑。
road.en: A plain with a marching column and red banners, Xuchang's walls in the distance. Layer: pursuing riders in a dust cloud.

letter.zh: 夜，烛光书案，信笺、毛笔、砚台。图层：药包；朱印；窗外江面火光。
letter.en: Night desk by candlelight: letter, brush, inkstone. Layers: medicine packet; red seal; river glow through a window.

hill.zh: 土山被围，山顶一将与两位女眷，山下敌营红旗，一骑来劝降。图层：一骑从山后小路突围。
hill.en: A surrounded earthen hill: a general and two ladies on top, enemy tents with red flags below, a lone rider approaching to parley. Layer: a rider escaping down the back path.

hall.zh: 厅堂内景，梁柱，门外天光。图层：梁上悬印、贴封条的箱笼；一匹赤红骏马。
hall.en: Hall interior, beams and pillars, daylight through the door. Layers: an official seal hanging from a beam and sealed chests; a red warhorse.

camp.zh: 北方营寨，群山，蓝红旗帜林立。
camp.en: A northern army camp among mountains, forests of blue and red banners.

mirror.zh: 竹林溪畔，隐士抚琴，二客远立。
mirror.en: Bamboo grove by a stream, a recluse playing the zither, two visitors standing at a distance.

snow.zh: 雪中茅庐，篱笆，门外数人立雪等候。图层：第四人（徐庶）。
snow.en: A thatched cottage in snow with a fence, several men waiting outside. Layer: a fourth man (Xu Shu).

bridge.zh: 长坂桥，一将横矛立马桥上，桥东树林，百姓奔逃。图层：林中尘土（疑兵）；白袍骑将救人。
bridge.en: Changban bridge: a general with a spear on horseback on the bridge, woods to the east, fleeing civilians. Layers: dust in the woods (feint); a white-robed rider rescuing.

slope.zh: 山坡上曹操与旌旗，坡下枪阵，一白袍将怀抱婴儿突围。图层：阵边缺口中逃出的车辆。
slope.en: Cao Cao and banners on a hilltop, spear ranks below, a white-robed general breaking through with an infant. Layer: carts escaping through a gap.

fog.zh: 大雾江面，远岸营火。图层：插满箭的草船。
fog.en: Fog on the river, distant campfires. Layer: straw boats bristling with arrows.

fire.zh: 赤壁夜江，铁索连舟。图层：火攻与红天；火船；后营空/后营起火；提灯小舟（接人）；下游未连锁的船。
fire.en: Night river at Red Cliffs, ships chained together. Layers: fire and red sky; fire ships; rear camp empty or burning; a small boat with a lantern (rescue); unchained ships downstream.

huarong.zh: 华容道，两侧峭壁，泥泞小路，残兵队列，一将立马拦路。图层：背药箱的女子在队尾。
huarong.en: Huarong road between cliffs, a muddy path, a column of defeated soldiers, a general blocking the way on horseback. Layer: a woman with a medicine chest at the rear.

campfire.zh: 夜营篝火，帐篷剪影，二人对坐火边，火星飞起。图层：城楼（古城）；横在膝上的刀。
campfire.en: A night camp: a fire with sparks, tent silhouettes, two men seated by the fire. Layers: a city wall (Gucheng); a blade across the knees.

riverbank.zh: 战后夜江，水面漂着焦木，远处余火，江边一名女子洗药杵。图层：身旁一名男子。
riverbank.en: The river at night after battle: charred timbers drifting, distant embers, a woman washing a pestle at the water's edge. Layer: a man beside her.

ending.zh: 尾声：晨江远山，红日。图层：两人同舟；江边茅屋炊烟；城郭；独立江岸；梅枝；远帆。
ending.en: Epilogue: river and mountains at dawn, red sun. Layers: two people in a boat; a cottage with smoke; city walls; a lone figure on the shore; plum branch; distant sail.

liubei.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，四十岁左右的汉室宗亲，面如冠玉，两耳垂肩，短须，小冠，青灰色交领长袍。表情：平静/温和/冷淡/忧伤/吃惊。
liubei.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: an imperial kinsman around forty, fair face, very long earlobes, short beard, small crown, grey-green crossed-collar robe. Expressions: neutral / warm / cold / sad / surprised.

guanyu.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，面如重枣，丹凤眼，卧蚕眉，长髯过胸，绿头巾，绿袍。表情同上。
guanyu.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: face the deep red of a jujube, phoenix eyes, thick 'silkworm' brows, a beard past the chest, green headscarf and green robe. Same expressions.

caocao.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，丞相，细眼，长须，高冠，深红黑色官袍。表情同上。
caocao.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: the Chancellor, narrow eyes, long thin beard, tall official hat, dark red-black robe. Same expressions.

zhuge.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，二十七岁，纶巾，白色鹤氅，手持羽扇，神情从容。表情同上。
zhuge.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: twenty-seven, silk scholar's cap, white crane-feather cloak, feather fan, composed. Same expressions.

wenzhi.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，原创人物：成年女医者，高髻，金簪，一朵梅花，浅蓝灰衣裙。表情同上，另加害羞。
wenzhi.en: Ink-wash bust portrait, original character: an adult woman physician, high bun, gold hairpin, a plum blossom, pale blue-grey dress. Same expressions plus shy.

note.en: Borders are schematic, not an exact historical map

c1.zh: 建安四年：曹操挟天子居许都，袁绍据河北
c1.en: 199: Cao Cao holds the Emperor at Xuchang; Yuan Shao holds the north

c2.zh: 刘备离开许都，夺回徐州
c2.en: Liu Bei leaves Xuchang and retakes Xuzhou

c3.zh: 曹操东征，徐州复归曹氏
c3.en: Cao Cao marches east and takes Xuzhou back

c4.zh: 官渡前后：曹、袁对峙于河北与中原之间
c4.en: Around Guandu: Cao and Yuan face off across the Yellow River

c5.zh: 建安十二年：曹操平定河北
c5.en: 207: Cao Cao has conquered the north

c6.en: Liu Cong surrenders Jingzhou to Cao

c7.zh: 赤壁：曹军南下，与孙、刘联军隔江相持
c7.en: Red Cliffs: Cao's army faces the Sun–Liu alliance across the river

c8.zh: 赤壁之后：荆州成为三方必争之地，三分之势初现
c8.en: After Red Cliffs: Jingzhou is contested, and a three-way split begins to show

kept_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，你做到了。她没有说什么，只是把你的手握得很紧。
kept_text.en: You kept your word to Wen Zhi. She says nothing—only holds your hand very tightly.

broken_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，被你自己拿去换了军报。她再提起这句话时，语气平得像在念药方。
broken_text.en: The promise you made Wen Zhi, you traded for military intelligence. When she mentions it again, her voice is as flat as a prescription.

kept_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，你做到了。她没有说什么，只是把你的手握得很紧。
kept_text.en: You kept your word to Wen Zhi. She says nothing—only holds your hand very tightly.

broken_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，被你自己拿去换了军报。她再提起这句话时，语气平得像在念药方。
broken_text.en: The promise you made Wen Zhi, you traded for military intelligence. When she mentions it again, her voice is as flat as a prescription.

kept_text.zh: 你对刘备说过不离不弃。一卷走完，你还在他身边。
kept_text.en: You told Liu Bei you'd never leave him. At the end of the volume, you're still at his side.

broken_text.zh: 你对刘备说过不离不弃。后来古城的消息传来，说他听说你留在了曹营，只说了一句：『人各有志。』
broken_text.en: You told Liu Bei you'd never leave him. Word reaches you that when he heard you'd stayed with Cao, he said only: 'Every man chooses his own road.'

kept_text.zh: 你对关羽许过的话，你守住了。在他那里，这比什么都重。
kept_text.en: You kept the word you gave Guan Yu. To him, nothing weighs more.

broken_text.zh: 你对关羽许过的话，没有守住。他再也不跟你喝酒了。
broken_text.en: You broke the word you gave Guan Yu. He never drinks with you again.

kept_text.zh: 你对曹操说过要尽忠。至少到这一卷为止，你做到了。
kept_text.en: You told Cao Cao you'd serve him faithfully. For this volume at least, you did.

broken_text.zh: 你对曹操说过要尽忠，却在长坂坡放走了刘备的家眷。他不知道。你知道。
broken_text.en: You swore loyalty to Cao Cao, then let Liu Bei's people go at Changban. He doesn't know. You do.
